Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#50.title: feat(track): Lithe-IDEA 组织插件自动合入，组织外插件仍需审查
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#50.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#50.body:
## 改动类型

- [ ] 收录新插件
- [ ] 新增版本
- [ ] 修改插件信息
- [ ] 撤回版本 / 下架插件（请写明原因）
- [x] 脚本、CI 或文档

## 插件

- 插件 ID：不涉及（本 PR 不改 `lithe-plugin-index.json`）
- 来源仓库：不涉及
- 版本 / Release 链接：不涉及

## 改动内容

#49 让 bot 自动发现并收录 Lithe-IDEA 组织的 `lithe-plugin-*` 仓库，但所有追踪结果仍在同一个 PR 里等人工合并。这个 PR 把扫描按插件仓库的所有者分成两轮：`repository` 属于 Lithe-IDEA 组织的插件（含首次收录）校验通过后由工作流直接合入 main；其他插件仍开 PR 等维护者审查。

**`scripts/track-releases.mjs`**
- 新增 `--scope organization|external`。`isOrganizationEntry` 按 `repository` 的所有者（不区分大小写）判断是否属于 Lithe-IDEA；`inScope` 决定一轮扫描要处理哪些条目，不传 `--scope` 时处理全部，行为与原来一致。
- 原来 `main` 里的追踪循环抽成可测试的 `trackIndex(index, { scope, onlyPlugin, request, downloadArchive, readManifests })`。`external` 这一轮不做组织发现，所以组织外插件永远不会被自动首次收录；发现的新插件只会出现在 `organization` 这一轮。
- `--scope` 传入未知值时退出码 2；`--plugin` 与 `--scope` 的参数值都不会被误当成索引路径。

**`.github/workflows/track-releases.yml`**
- 一个 job 用 matrix 跑两轮（`max-parallel: 1`，先组织后组织外，`fail-fast: false`），每轮维护一个 PR：
  | | Lithe-IDEA 组织插件 | 组织外插件 |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | 分支 | `bot/track-organization-releases` | `bot/track-releases` |
  | PR 标题 | `chore(index): 追踪 Lithe-IDEA 组织插件新版本` | `chore(index): 追踪组织外插件新版本` |
  | 合入 | 校验通过后工作流自动合入 | 维护者审查后合并 |
- 组织那一轮的合入方式：开 PR 之前已经运行 `validate-index.mjs --verify-archives --base`（与 `Validate index` 对新增归档的检查相同）；之后用 app token 执行 `gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit <本轮校验过的提交>`（与仓库现有的 squash 历史一致；分支在校验之后被改动过，GitHub 会拒绝合并），合并后删除分支。
- 为什么用 GitHub App：main 由规则集 “Only owners merge main” 保护。GitHub 不允许把 GitHub Actions 加入仓库规则集的绕过名单（API 返回 `Actor GitHub Actions integration must be part of the ruleset source or owner organization`），Lithe-IDEA 组织又禁用了 deploy key（添加时返回 `Deploy keys are disabled for this repository`），所以用组织自己的私有 GitHub App “Lithe Store Bot” 作为唯一的 bot 绕过者。只有组织那一轮会用 `actions/create-github-app-token@v3` 生成 app token；组织外那一轮仍用 `STORE_BOT_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN`，写不了 main。
- 没有配置 Lithe Store Bot（仓库变量为空时不生成 app token），或者合并失败时，只输出 `::warning::`，PR 保持打开，由维护者审查合并。合并这一步只用 app token，不回退到其他 token。
- 某一轮没有发现 main 尚未收录的版本时，自动关闭这一轮遗留的 PR（只指定一个插件的手动运行不会关闭）。
- job 只在 `main` 上运行（同 `Sync README`），checkout 固定 `ref: main`：组织外那一轮要从组织那一轮刚更新过的 main 开始；从其他分支手动启动时不会用新工作流配旧脚本而误合入组织外插件。
- PR 的查找改为 `gh pr list --head <分支> --state open` 取编号，避免同名分支有已合并的旧 PR 时找错。
- PR 描述按范围说明合入方式；参数改用 bash 数组传递（shellcheck 无告警）。
- 用 app token 开的 PR 会触发 `Validate index`；合并到 main 也会触发 main 上的 `Validate index` 和 `Sync README`，README 总览已在 PR 里重新生成，所以不会再产生同步 PR。

**文档**
- `docs/maintainers.md`：两轮扫描的范围、分支、合入方式对照表；自动合入的三个步骤和失败时的回退；信任边界（在组织插件仓库能发 Release、或能在组织里建公开 `lithe-plugin-*` 仓库的人，都能不经 Store 审查发布到 Store；组织允许成员创建公开仓库时，每个成员都在这个范围内）；“需要的仓库设置”改为 Lithe Store Bot、`STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID`、`STORE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`、规则集绕过名单的真实配置，删掉原来与实际不符的“分支保护要求 Validate 与 CODEOWNERS 审查”；审查清单注明组织插件的 bot PR 不走人工清单，首次收录的组织插件合入后由维护者补 icon、中文简介并检查 description/tags。
- `docs/publishing.md`：首次收录和发布新版本两节说明组织插件自动合入、组织外插件由维护者审查。
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`：任务表、`track-releases.mjs` 与工作流说明同步更新。

**测试（`scripts/store.test.mjs`）**
- `isOrganizationEntry` 对大小写和末尾斜杠的判断。
- 同一份索引（一个组织插件、一个组织外插件，各有一个新 Release）：`organization` 只追踪组织插件并做组织发现；`external` 只请求组织外插件的 Release，不请求组织仓库列表，`newPlugins` 为空；不传 scope 时两者都追踪。断言每轮实际发出的 GitHub 请求，确认不会跨范围。

## 合并前需要的仓库设置

需要组织管理员运行一次配置脚本（GitHub App manifest 流程）：浏览器打开预填好的“创建 GitHub App”页面（私有、不接收 webhook、只有 Contents 与 Pull requests 读写），点 Create 后脚本把 Client ID 存为仓库变量 `STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID`、私钥直接存为 secret `STORE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`（不落盘）；接着在安装页只选 Lithe-store；脚本确认 App 能访问 Lithe-store 后，把它加进 “Only owners merge main” 的绕过名单。没有配置时，组织那一轮只开 PR 并给出警告，不会报错，所以先合并这个 PR、后做设置也可以。

绕过名单按 App ID 指定，只放行 Lithe Store Bot，不放行其他 App 或 deploy key。删除仓库变量 `STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID` 或卸载这个 App 就会停用自动合入。

## 验证

- `node --test scripts/store.test.mjs`：52 通过，0 失败。
- `node scripts/validate-index.mjs lithe-plugin-index.json`：12 个插件全部有效（本 PR 不改索引）。
- `actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`：只有两条关于 `actions/create-github-app-token@v3` 的误报（“缺少 app-id”“没有 client-id 输入”）。actionlint 1.7.12（当前最新）内置的是旧版元数据；v3.3.0 的 `action.yml` 里 `client-id` 是推荐输入，`app-id` 已废弃且不再必填。仓库 CI 不运行 actionlint。
- 基于最新 main（已含 #48 的 Lua 0.3.1），用真实 GitHub 数据分范围 dry-run：`--scope organization --dry-run` 没有新版本（keymap-import 只有 pre-release，被跳过）；`--scope external --dry-run` 输出 `io.github.fxrayhughes.mise@0.1.0 (v0.1.0)`。合并后下一轮扫描会在 `bot/track-releases` 开一个组织外 PR 收录 mise 0.1.0，等待审查。

## 自检

- [x] 我是该插件的作者或维护者（或已获得授权）（不涉及具体插件）
- [x] `plugin.json` 的 `vendor.signatureRequirement` 为 `"none"`，ID 不在 `dev.lithe.*`（自动合入同样经过这项校验）
- [ ] 已在本地运行 `node scripts/validate-index.mjs --verify-archives`（本 PR 不改索引，没有新包需要校验）
- [x] 插件要运行的程序都已在 `plugin.json` 中声明，并在仓库 README 中说明（不涉及）
- [x] 没有修改已发布版本的 `downloadURL` / `sha256`，没有删除历史版本（撤回除外）
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#50.head: feat/track-org-auto-merge

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#51.title: chore(index): 追踪 Lithe-IDEA 组织插件新版本
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#51.author: github-actions

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#53.title: fix(track): 用 Lithe Store Bot（GitHub App）合入组织插件
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#53.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#53.body:
## 改动类型

- [ ] 收录新插件
- [ ] 新增版本
- [ ] 修改插件信息
- [ ] 撤回版本 / 下架插件（请写明原因）
- [x] 脚本、CI 或文档

## 插件

- 插件 ID：不涉及（本 PR 不改 `lithe-plugin-index.json`）
- 来源仓库：不涉及
- 版本 / Release 链接：不涉及

## 改动内容

#50 用 deploy key 合入组织插件，但 Lithe-IDEA 组织禁用了 deploy key（添加时返回 `Deploy keys are disabled for this repository`），GitHub 也不允许把 GitHub Actions 加入仓库规则集的绕过名单。所以 #51（maven-build 0.1.2）只能保持打开并给出警告。这个 PR 改用组织自己的私有 GitHub App “Lithe Store Bot” 作为唯一的 bot 绕过者。

**`.github/workflows/track-releases.yml`**
- 新增步骤 “Create the Lithe Store Bot token”：只在组织那一轮、并且仓库变量 `STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID` 不为空时，用 `actions/create-github-app-token@v3`（`client-id` + secret `STORE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`）生成只能访问本仓库的 app token。
- 删除 checkout 的 `ssh-key` 和 job 级 `GH_TOKEN`。checkout 以及三个调用 gh 的步骤统一使用同一个 token，优先级是 app token、可选的 `STORE_BOT_TOKEN`、`GITHUB_TOKEN`。组织外那一轮不生成 app token，写不了 main。用 app token 开的 PR 会触发 `Validate index`。
- “Merge the organization pull request” 只使用 app token，不回退到其他 token。没有 app token 时给出警告，PR 保持打开。合并方式由“用 deploy key 快进 main，再轮询等 PR 变成 MERGED”改为 `gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit <本轮校验过的提交>`：与仓库现有的 squash 历史一致；分支在校验之后被改动过时，GitHub 拒绝合并。合并失败时给出警告，PR 保持打开；合并成功后删除分支。

**`docs/maintainers.md`**
- 自动合入的步骤改为 app token + squash 合并，回退条件和停用方法改为“删除仓库变量 `STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID` 或卸载 App”。
- 信任边界补充：组织允许成员创建公开仓库时，每个组织成员都能不经 Store 审查，通过新建 `lithe-plugin-*` 仓库并发布 Release 把插件发布到 Store。
- “需要的仓库设置”把 deploy key 改为 Lithe Store Bot：私有，只有 Contents 与 Pull requests 读写，不接收 webhook，只安装在本仓库。同时写明变量和 secret 的名字，说明规则集为什么用 App 绕过、绕过只放行这一个 App。
- README 同步一节的“不使用 deploy key”改为“不使用 Lithe Store Bot”。

## 合并前后需要的设置

组织管理员运行一次配置脚本（GitHub App manifest 流程）：
1. 浏览器打开预填好的创建页面，点 Create。
2. 脚本把 Client ID 存为变量 `STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID`，私钥直接存为 secret `STORE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`，不落盘。
3. 在安装页只选 Lithe-store。
4. 脚本确认 App 能访问 Lithe-store 后，把它加进 “Only owners merge main” 的绕过名单。

没有配置时，组织那一轮行为和现在一样，只给出警告，所以设置可以在合并前做，也可以在合并后做。

## 验证

- `node --test scripts/store.test.mjs`：52 通过，0 失败（本 PR 不改脚本）。
- `actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`：只有两条关于 `actions/create-github-app-token@v3` 的误报（“缺少 app-id”“没有 client-id 输入”）。actionlint 1.7.12（当前最新）内置的是旧版元数据；v3.3.0 的 `action.yml` 里推荐使用 `client-id`，`app-id` 已废弃且不再必填。仓库 CI 不运行 actionlint。
- 配置脚本的单元测试：manifest 表单转义后原样提交到组织的创建页面，权限、私有、关闭 webhook、回调地址都正确；JWT 用 RS256 签名、有效期覆盖当前时间；更新绕过名单时保留 OrganizationAdmin，不重复添加 App。
- 现有线上运行（#50 的版本）已验证分范围扫描：组织那一轮开了 #51（maven-build 0.1.2），因为没有凭据只给出警告；组织外那一轮开了 #52（mise 0.1.0）等待审查。

## 自检

- [x] 我是该插件的作者或维护者（或已获得授权）（不涉及具体插件）
- [x] `plugin.json` 的 `vendor.signatureRequirement` 为 `"none"`，ID 不在 `dev.lithe.*`（不涉及）
- [ ] 已在本地运行 `node scripts/validate-index.mjs --verify-archives`（本 PR 不改索引）
- [x] 插件要运行的程序都已在 `plugin.json` 中声明，并在仓库 README 中说明（不涉及）
- [x] 没有修改已发布版本的 `downloadURL` / `sha256`，没有删除历史版本（撤回除外）

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#54.title: chore(index): 撤回 Maven 0.1.2，稳定版用户留在 0.1.1
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#54.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#54.body:
## 改动

- `lithe-plugin-index.json`：删除 `io.github.lithe-idea.maven-build` 的 `0.1.2` 版本条目，保留 0.1.1 和 0.1.0；其他插件不变。
- `README.md`：用 `node scripts/render-readme.mjs` 重新生成插件总览，Maven 显示版本从 v0.1.2 回到 v0.1.1。

## 原因

Maven 0.1.2 的构建后端基于 Java SDK 的 litheLogging 1 实现，只能在提供 litheLogging 1 的 Lithe preview 开发版上启动。稳定版 Lithe 0.6.7 没有 litheLogging 1：插件能安装，但构建后端启动失败。

v0.1.2 的发布工作流把它列在 `PRERELEASE_TAGS` 里，发布说明也写着“预发布版本，Lithe Store 自动追踪会跳过”，但 GitHub 上的 Release 最终是正式版，#51 的自动追踪于是收录了它，稳定版用户会被推送一个启动不了的更新。

- GitHub Release v0.1.2 已改回预发布，v0.1.1 重新标为 Latest，追踪器不会再收录 0.1.2。
- 插件 `requires` 能力表里没有和 litheLogging 对应的能力，索引没法只对 preview 版本开放 0.1.2，所以按[维护者文档的下架规则](docs/maintainers.md#下架与撤回)删除这个版本条目；0.1.1 是可用的替代版本。
- 已经装了 0.1.2 的用户不受影响（删除条目只阻止新的安装和更新）。

Maven 插件后续改为锁定官方发布的 Java SDK 0.3.0 并继续以预发布发版，Release 工作流会加上发布后读回预发布状态的校验，在 lithe-plugin-maven 单独提 PR。

## 验证

- `node scripts/validate-index.mjs lithe-plugin-index.json`：12 个插件全部有效，格式规范
- `node scripts/render-readme.mjs --check`：总览一致
- `node --test scripts/store.test.mjs`：52/52 通过

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#55.title: docs: 不再区分官方插件和普通插件，按收录方式说明
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#55.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#55.body:
## 背景

Lithe 不再区分官方插件和普通插件，所有插件都按普通插件处理。区别只在收录方式：Lithe-IDEA 组织的插件自动收录，组织外的插件提 PR 审核。Java 插件也在 Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java#3 改为普通插件身份 `io.github.lithe-idea.java-support`。

## 改动

**CONTRIBUTING.md**
- “社区插件与官方插件”一节改为“插件如何收录”，拆成两张表：
  - 统一规则：ID 不得使用 `dev.lithe.*`（组织插件用 `io.github.lithe-idea.*`）；`vendor.signatureRequirement: "none"`，不带发布者签名，索引固定 SHA-256，安装后记录内容摘要并在每次加载时复查；安装前弹窗确认权限、要运行的程序和来源仓库。
  - 收录方式：Lithe-IDEA 组织下公开的 `lithe-plugin-*` 仓库（`lithe-plugin-docs` 除外）由 bot 发现正式 Release 后自动收录，新版本的 bot PR 校验通过后自动合入；组织外插件首次收录要提 PR 或开收录申请 issue，新版本的 bot PR 都由维护者按审查清单审核后合并。
- 删除原表里“官方插件索引在主仓库、`dev.lithe.*`、Ed25519 签名、直接安装”这一列。
- 新增一句：主仓库仍内置少量迁移前的 `dev.lithe.*` 插件，正在逐个迁出为组织插件，迁出后同样由本仓库收录。

**统一措辞（只改用词，不改规则）**
- `README.md`：标题“Lithe 的社区插件市场”改为“Lithe 的插件市场”；“社区插件由各自的开发者维护”改为“所有插件由各自的开发者维护”；“预置本仓库作为社区插件源”改为“作为插件源”。三处都在 `plugins:start`/`plugins:end` 生成块之外。
- `docs/publishing.md`：标题“发布社区插件”改为“发布插件”；“社区插件额外要求”改为“收录到本仓库的插件额外要求”；“社区包不带 Lithe 签名”改为“插件包不带发布者签名”。
- `docs/maintainers.md`：链接文字“发布社区插件的首次收录”改为“发布插件的首次收录”（锚点不变）。

自动收录和自动合入的说法与 `docs/maintainers.md`、`.github/workflows/track-releases.yml` 当前行为一致，本 PR 不改任何脚本或工作流。

## 验证

- `node --test scripts/store.test.mjs`：52 个通过。
- `node scripts/render-readme.mjs --check`：README 生成块是最新的。
- `node scripts/validate-index.mjs lithe-plugin-index.json`：12 个插件有效。

## 相关 PR

- Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java#3：Java 插件改为普通插件身份 `io.github.lithe-idea.java-support`
- 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1754：主仓库 Agent Note 记录身份改定和阶段 E 的前置条件

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#58.title: feat!: 索引和校验切到插件契约 v0，撤下旧契约条目
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#58.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#58.body:
## 改动类型

- [ ] 收录新插件
- [ ] 新增版本
- [ ] 修改插件信息
- [x] 撤回版本 / 下架插件（请写明原因）
- [x] 脚本、CI 或文档

撤回原因：插件契约在 Core PR Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-core-rust#17 把所有格式版本归零（索引 `schemaVersion` 0、清单 `schemaVersion` 0、`pluginAPIVersion` 0、能力版本 0）。现有条目都是旧契约（插件 API 1–4）的包，新版桌面端（`desktop-v*`）装不了，所以整份索引切到 v0 并撤下全部旧条目。各插件按 v0 重新发布后（从 0.0.1 开始）再逐个收录。

## 改动内容

- `scripts/validate-index.mjs`
  - 索引 `schemaVersion` 必须是 0，否则报 `plugin.index.schemaUnsupported`。
  - 版本项 `pluginAPIVersion` 为非负整数，非 0 表示当前宿主不可用而不是无效，与 Core 的索引规则一致。
  - `requires` 必填且非空，能力 ID 匹配 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}$`，版本为非负整数。
  - 归档校验（`checkManifest`）拒绝 `schemaVersion` 或 `pluginAPIVersion` 不是 0 的包，错误码为 `plugin.schema.unsupported` / `plugin.api.unsupported`。自动追踪逐个 Release 资产调用它，所以旧契约的 Release 不会被收录。
- `scripts/track-releases.mjs`：版本项始终写入排好序的 `requires`，并按 v0 索引校验。
- `scripts/fixtures/{index,invalid-index-entries}.json`：换成 Core `shared/plugins/contract/v1/fixtures/marketplace` 的 v0 副本。`scripts/store.test.mjs` 按 v0 重写。
- `.github/workflows/validate.yml`：schema 改为对照 Core 仓库的 `plugin-index.schema.json`（固定 SHA-256），不再指向已退役的 lithe-plugin-docs。schema 取不到（404）时改为报错退出。
- `lithe-plugin-index.json`：改为 `{"schemaVersion": 0, "plugins": []}`。README 的插件总览随之重新生成。
- 文档：`README.md`、`CONTRIBUTING.md`、`docs/publishing.md`、`docs/versioning-and-updates.md`、`docs/maintainers.md` 改为指向 Core `shared/plugins`，写明 v0 规则、`requires` 字段和预发布手工收录流程。`docs/maintainers.md` 还记录了这次切换和它对旧版 Lithe 的影响。

**影响**：旧版 macOS Lithe 会拒绝整份索引，它的插件市场无法再读取 Lithe Store。已装的插件不受影响。

**合并顺序**：插件仓库的 CI 会克隆 Store `main`，并导入 `checkManifest` 检查包。所以这个 PR 要先合，Go、LLDB、Maven 的 v0 PR 才能通过 CI。

## 插件

- 插件 ID：—（不收录新插件）
- 来源仓库：—
- 版本 / Release 链接：—

## 自检

- [x] 我是该插件的作者或维护者（或已获得授权）
- [x] `plugin.json` 的 `vendor.signatureRequirement` 为 `"none"`，ID 不在 `dev.lithe.*`（索引为空）
- [x] 已在本地运行 `node scripts/validate-index.mjs --verify-archives`
- [x] 插件要运行的程序都已在 `plugin.json` 中声明，并在仓库 README 中说明（不适用）
- [x] 没有修改已发布版本的 `downloadURL` / `sha256`，没有删除历史版本（撤回除外）

本地验证：`node --test scripts/store.test.mjs` 52/52 通过；`node scripts/validate-index.mjs --verify-archives` 通过。

## 自检

用户工作流验收在上架后从市场重新下载的包进行，结果单独报告。

## 上架后的实际包验收

从已合入的市场索引重新下载包并校验 SHA-256。macOS arm64 当前客户端的真实插件工作流通过安装、补全、构建、运行、断点、变量、继续、主动停止、编译失败阻止旧 class 以及包目录哈希不变检查。Maven 15.43 秒，Gradle 双模块 63.28 秒；这些是单次流程耗时，不是性能基准。原生客户端完成三个插件的市场安装，并验证 Maven compile、main 输出和断点变量；原生 Gradle 全流程及 Windows 本轮未复验。发现下载无明显进度、权限审阅在主窗口后方及审阅显示大段原始程序 JSON 的体验问题，未据此宣称原生体验完全验收。

| --- | --- | --- |
| `io.github.lithe-idea.gradle-build` | [lithe-plugin-gradle](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-gradle) | [1.1.0](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-gradle/releases/tag/v1.1.0) |

| `io.github.lithe-idea.maven-build` | [lithe-plugin-maven](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-maven) | [0.2.0](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-maven/releases/tag/v0.2.0) |

四个新版本均提供 Linux ARM64 和 x64，保留各插件此前已有的平台。Gradle/Maven 的 Linux 包为同一份可移植 Java 资源；Java Support/Lite 各发布两种架构的原生包。继续使用插件契约 v0、原有能力要求及 GitHub 预发布策略，适用于 Lithe 桌面预览版。

新增版本的下载地址来自实际发布附件，SHA-256 由下载的 ZIP 计算，并核对包内清单。所有历史版本、URL、SHA-256 和旧平台都保留；README 只同步生成区。

## 自检

- [x] 我是该插件的作者或维护者（或已获得授权）：维护者明确要求补齐四个插件并更新市场

- [ ] 本机完整下载校验：本机大包下载受带宽限制；同一命令已在 [Linux runner 上完整通过](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store/actions/runs/43621713669)，本地完成单元测试、索引规则与生成结果检查。
- [x] 插件要运行的程序都已在 `plugin.json` 中声明，并在仓库 README 中说明
- [x] 没有修改已发布版本的 `downloadURL` / `sha256`，没有删除历史版本（撤回除外）

## 验证

- [Gradle Linux x64/ARM64](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-gradle/actions/runs/43619648231)：Gradle 7.6/9.6.1 真实模型、构建、测试、依赖和后端协议。
- [Maven Linux x64/ARM64](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-maven/actions/runs/43620181057)：当前 Maven 和 3.6.3 的真实模型、依赖、筛选测试和归档校验。
- [Java Support Lite Linux x64/ARM64](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java-navigation/actions/runs/43619657113)：包内二进制 ELF/权限、LSP 握手、文档符号、关闭与安装目录不变；保留 Windows 测试。
- [Java Support Linux x64/ARM64 及 macOS 回归](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java/actions/runs/43620297805)：包内后端、JDK、JDT LS 真实启动/关闭、安装目录哈希和权限不变，macOS 双架构归档回归及 Rust 检查。
- `node --test --test-timeout=60000 scripts/store.test.mjs`

## 改动类型

#68 收录的 1.0.0 发布后几分钟，发现 Delve 调试在多模块工作区（根目录没有 `go.mod`）里报 `Build error`，所以删除了那次的 Release 和 tag，修复后以同一版本号重发：

- 修复：Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#11（Delve 在包目录编译和运行）、#12（发布说明补上 Core 依赖）；
- 依赖 Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-core-rust#55（`targetBindings.adapterArguments`）和 #56（`cwd` ← `target.directory`）；
- 重发的 tag `v1.0.0` 指向 lithe-plugin-go main `8595a25`。

原条目的下载地址在删除期间是 404，现在重新可用，但包变了，原来的 `sha256` 对不上，安装会在哈希校验时失败。

## 条目内容

- 只改 1.0.0 唯一一个下载项的 `sha256`：`e7089f29…cadbe9f` → `69462f3a4207f0a62477abb469ea849abe4d13c177f125da0dc365b8dd967b22`。这个值来自 Release 资产，GitHub 资产 digest 和下载后用 `shasum -a 256` 算出的一致。
- `downloadURL`、`requires`、`releaseDate`、名称、描述、图标都不变。`requires` 已逐项对过新包里的 `plugin.json`（buildSystems、commandInstallers、debugAdapters、languageServers、languages、projectGenerators、settings、toolDefinitions，都是 0）。
- 0.0.1 保持不变。

宿主兼容：新包用了 Core #55 的 `targetBindings.adapterArguments`。没有这个字段的宿主会以 `plugin.manifest.invalid` 拒绝安装 1.0.0，因为调试适配器的清单是 `deny_unknown_fields`，能力版本仍是 `debugAdapters` 0，索引里没法区分。需要桌面端包含 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1975（Core #55、#56）。当前的 `desktop-AutoBuild` 基于 1lck/Lithe-IDEA main `9b36ed77b`，在 #1975 之前，所以要等下一次 AutoBuild 才能装上 1.0.0。

## 自检

- [x] 我是该插件的作者或维护者（或已获得授权）
- [x] `plugin.json` 的 `vendor.signatureRequirement` 为 `"none"`，ID 不在 `dev.lithe.*`
- [x] 已在本地运行 `node scripts/validate-index.mjs lithe-plugin-index.json --verify-archives --base <main 的索引>`：和 CI 一样只下载了哈希变化的 go-support 1.0.0，结果 verified，5 个条目全部有效；`--write-format` 没有改动
- [x] 插件要运行的程序都已在 `plugin.json` 中声明，并在仓库 README 中说明（gopls、go、dlv）
- [ ] 没有修改已发布版本的 `downloadURL` / `sha256`，没有删除历史版本（撤回除外）：**例外**。这次修改了 1.0.0 的 `sha256`，原因是维护者要求以同一版本号重发，原来的包已经不存在。`downloadURL` 不变，没有删除历史版本。

验证：重发的包已经在 lithe-plugin-go 的宿主 e2e（`node scripts/e2e-host.mjs`，宿主为 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1976，Core `9425469`）中通过 `TestOfficialGoPluginDebugsEachProjectOfAWorkspaceWithDelve` 和 `TestOfficialGoPluginBuildsAndServesAModule`。CI 打出的包和本地打出的包内容逐文件一致，只有 zip 字节不同。没有在宿主里从插件市场实际安装。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#88.title: track-releases：组织插件不会自动合并（Store Bot 应用未配置），按插件触发会覆盖同一个 PR
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#88.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#88.body:
## 问题

`track-releases` 工作流的 organization 范围本应在校验安装包后自己合并 PR，但现在总是停在打开状态，需要所有者手动合并。另外，按插件分别手动触发时，后一次运行会覆盖前一次的 PR，前一次追踪到的版本从 PR 里消失。

## 现象（2026-11-18）

1. 自动合并没有发生。运行 44268172532 的日志：
   `The Lithe Store Bot app is not configured (STORE_BOT_APP_CLIENT_ID, STORE_BOT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY), so pull request #87 stays open for a maintainer to merge.`
   组织插件的新版本（这次是 Java Support 4.0.2 和 Tomcat 0.0.1）因此都要等人工合并，和工作流注释、PR 正文里写的“校验通过后直接合入 main”不符。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#9.title: docs: 补齐 LSP 插件完整生命周期与构建接入教程
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#9.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-store#9.body:
插件作者现有的发布说明缺少从语言服务器打包到运行、停止和版本切换的开发路径。本次新增中文教程，以 macOS 声明式插件和 Lua 模板串起完整生命周期，并提供可合并进清单的运行、测试示例。

## 变更

- 新增 LSP 生命周期教程：最小清单、模板派生、固定上游版本及 SHA-256、归档验证、三种启动方式、API 2 状态目录和运行时、社区源安装、LSP 协议与故障排查。
- 补齐启用、禁用、关闭、取消、更新、上一版本回滚和卸载的验收步骤，说明重启生效、状态归属及进程清理边界。
- 新增构建/运行/测试指南，包含 Lua 运行、Go 运行与三个测试范围的 JSON 示例；区分现有 executionProviders、官方 JDT 集成及开发中的 API 3 buildSystems。
- 将教程接入首页、贡献说明和发布文档导航。操作示例限定 macOS，明确 Windows 独立扩展实现及 API 3 尚未形成通用宿主工作流。

## 验证

- `node --test scripts/store.test.mjs`：30 项通过。
- `node scripts/validate-index.mjs --verify-archives`：索引及全部已发布归档通过。
- 6 组完整/合并 JSON 示例通过 Lithe 已提交的 API 1/2 Schema，以及语言引用、权限和激活事件检查；两个仓库合计 41 个本地/跨仓库文件链接及锚点通过检查。
- Lua 模板 0.3.0 的 macOS arm64/x64 包构建和 Store 归档校验通过。
- 本机实际验证 API 1 启动器、API 2 直接启动 LuaLS 两条路径的 initialize → initialized → shutdown → exit；均正常退出，包内容与权限保持不变。
- Lithe 界面中的安装、补全、更新和回滚尚未实测，已作为发布前人工验收项列入教程；共享校验不代表 Windows 产品验收。

核对基线：Lithe `826b3063` 的已提交 API 1/2 契约，以及工作区中尚在开发、市场排除的 API 3 能力。新文档链接在本地按文件与锚点验证，合入后才会出现在 main 上。

## 配套 PR

Lua 模板入口与验收说明：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-lua/pull/2

合入顺序：先合入本 PR，再合入 Lua 模板 PR，使模板中的 Store main 文档链接生效。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#1.title: feat(app): Window.SetTitle changes a window's title after it opens
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#1.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#1.body:
## Changes
- New `app.Window.SetTitle(title string) error`: changes the window title after the window opens. The title shows in the system title bar, the task switcher and the taskbar or Dock window list. It is safe to call from any goroutine. Hosts without support return an error that wraps `ErrUnsupported`.
- macOS: `viva_application_set_title` sets the NSWindow title on the main thread and updates the delegate's `_title`.
- Windows: the new title is stored first and then posted to the window thread as `wmSetTitle` (0x8052). The window thread applies it with `SetWindowTextW` and also updates the accessibility tree's window name. A direct call from another thread would block on WM_SETTEXT, so the change is posted instead.
- Linux: the GTK toplevel title is set on the GTK thread.
- headless: the new title appears in the `windows` listing.
- README and `docs/conformance.md` updated; unit test `TestSetTitleDelegatesToTheHost` added.

Purpose: Lithe IDE (1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1799) needs the window title and the Windows taskbar entry to follow the current project and file.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#10.title: feat(components): let applications set tree arrows, bar geometry and tooltip surface
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#10.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#10.body:
## 这个 PR 做什么

Lithe 的 Viva 客户端要按 IDEA 的规格重做三处共享控件，Viva 原来把它们的几何和配色写死在组件里，应用侧无处落地。这次把三处改成“应用可以覆盖、留空用 Viva 自己的”：

| 能力 | 入口 | 可设项 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 树箭头 | `components.TreeDisclosure`（经 `ui.TreeState.Disclosure`） | 折叠/展开图标、图标尺寸、箭头列宽；`ui` 的行内边距跟着同一个列宽走 |
| 滚动条 | `components.ScrollBarStyle`（`ScrollArea.Bars`） | 轨道宽、hover 覆盖条宽、轨道内边距、最小滑块长；`ScrollAreaGeometry` 记录内边距，拖动换算用同一个值 |
| 提示框 | `gfx.TooltipStyle`（`Theme.Tooltip`） | 圆角、内边距、字号、背景、文字、边框粗细与颜色；箭头用同一圆角与填充色，边框画在主体之后，圆角仍归主体 |

三项都保持默认兼容：零值字段全部回退到 Viva 现有行为，因此不影响已有应用。

## 测试

- `components/tree_disclosure_test.go`：自定义列宽移动行内容、默认仍是 24pt 列
- `components/scroll_area_bars_test.go`：自定义轨道/内边距/最小滑块、默认几何不变
- `components/tooltip_style_test.go`：自定义内边距与字号改变盒子高度、默认保持
- `cmd/viva/initfiles/AGENTS.md.txt` 补 `Tooltip` 字段说明（`ui` 的指南校验要求列出每个主题字段）

`go test ./components/ ./ui/ ./gfx/` 通过。`go test ./...` 里 `cmd/viva` 的打包/签名用例在本机会失败，报 “built for macOS 13.0 or later but min_system says 12.0”，在 `lithe/main` 上复跑同样失败，属本机 CGO 部署目标的环境问题，与本改动无关。

## 后续

- 合并后按仓库约定同一修复分支向上游 `vivaui/viva` 提 PR。
- 然后 Lithe 侧把 `desktop/go.mod` 的 `replace` 提到本 PR 的合并提交，接入这三项的调用。
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#10.head: feat/1799-shared-controls

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#11.title: merge: bring the window, menu and markdown patches onto main
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#11.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#11.body:
## 为什么

`main` 上一直没有 Lithe 固定的那 6 个 fork 补丁（`Window.SetTitle`、`Config.OnFocusLost`、`ui.MenuAt`、MarkdownView 图片、改标题后红绿灯居中、`MenuItems.Beside`），它们只在 `fix/list-follow-end` 那条线上（也就是 `v0.6.1-0.20261111102951-7850516be532` 指向的提交）。#10 是基于 `main` 做的，合并后 `main` 缺这些补丁，Lithe 侧一提升 pin 就编译失败。

本 PR 把那条线合进 `main`，让 `main` 同时带上 6 个补丁和 #10 的控件扩展，Lithe 可以重新只固定一个提交。

## 冲突处理

只有 `ui/list.go` 冲突：两边都在修“列表请求的滚动要在同一帧生效”。
- 一边是 `if end := max(...); end != scroll.Offset { ... }` 的带变更判断写法
- 另一边（`main`）是 `snapScroll` 吸附整像素并把 offset 写回布局节点

取 `main` 的写法：它同时满足两边意图（既在同一帧显示请求的终点，又保住字形纹理），且下方 `bottom := offset + viewport` 读的就是同一个 `offset`。

## 验证

- `go build ./...` 通过
- `go test ./ui/ ./components/ ./gfx/` 通过

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#14.title: ui: TooltipOn opens a Tooltip beside a chosen side
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#14.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#14.body:
## Problem

`HoverTooltip.Paint` always opens a tip below its control (`options.Side = TooltipBottom`). An information icon at the end of a settings label then puts its tip over the rows under it, and an app can't open it to the right the way native settings panes do.

## Change

- `components.TooltipOptions.SideOf func(gfx.ID) TooltipSide`: `HoverTooltip` asks it which side to use for the hovered id. Nil still means below.
- `ui.Box.TooltipOn(side)` records a side for each element. It is kept with the element's other extras, so a Memo copy keeps it. `ui.TooltipSide` and `ui.TooltipTop/Right/Bottom/Left` alias the components types.
- `frame.paintTooltip` passes `SideOf`, which looks up the element the same way `hasTooltip` does.
- `PlaceOverlay` is unchanged and still flips to the opposite side when there's no room.

```go
ui.Button(c, "").Icon(info).Tooltip("Applies to new terminals").TooltipOn(ui.TooltipRight)
```

## Tests

`TestTooltipOn` (with and without Memo): the tip opens to the right of a control given `TooltipOn(ui.TooltipRight)` and below one without it. The test fails without the `SideOf` wiring. `go test ./ui ./components` passes.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#14.head: fix/tooltip-side

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#15.title: components: size menu rows by the theme's control height
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#15.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#15.body:
## What this changes

Menu item rows take the theme's control height instead of a fixed 32px:

- `components/dropdown_menu.go`: `menuThemeRowHeight(theme)` is the row height of a menu surface. It returns `theme.Metrics.ControlHeight` and falls back to the old 32 (`menuRowHeight`) for a theme without one. `menuSurface.itemHeight()` and `menuItemHeight` both use it when no row height was set, so the rows a menu paints and the height `ui.MenuItems` reserves for them (`ContextMenuItemHeight`, `DropdownMenuItemHeight`) stay the same.
- Every menu built on `menuSurface` follows the theme: `ContextMenu`, `DropdownMenu` and `MenubarContent`, and so `ui.ContextMenu` and `ui.Menu` too.
- Heights by density: 32 at the default density (unchanged), 26 at `DensityCompact`, 40 at `DensityLarge`.
- `ContextMenuOptions.RowHeight` still wins when it is set.
- Labels (28) and separators (9) keep their size, as the `RowHeight` doc already says.
- Doc comments on `NextItemBounds`, `RowHeight` and `ContextMenuItemHeight` now say what zero means.
- The `context_menu` and `dropdown_menu` installer templates are regenerated with `go run ./tools/componentgen`.

`Select` and `Combobox` keep their own 32px option rows. They are separate list components, not menu surfaces, and are out of scope here.

## Why

An application that sets `Metrics.WithDensity(DensityCompact)` gets 26px buttons, inputs and tabs, but its context menus kept 32px rows. A right-click menu was then the loosest surface in an otherwise compact window, noticeably sparser than the platform menus it sits next to. The only way around it was passing `RowHeight` on every menu, and `ui.ContextMenu` has no way to pass it.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: `components` and `ui` pass. Two kinds of failures in `cmd/viva` also happen on the base commit without this change:
  - `TestGeneratedRecipesAreCurrent` / `TestInstalledRecipesMatchReferenceSource` report a stale `color_swatch` template from c1b073c. That template is left alone here.
  - The `TestPackage*` tests fail on this machine because the toolchain builds for macOS 13.0 while the fixture says `min_system` 12.0.
- [N/A] platform vet: no backend is touched
- [x] benchmarks before and after (below)
- [N/A] stripped binary size: nothing new links
- [ ] a real window: verified in tests only, see below

New test `TestMenuRowsFollowTheThemeControlHeight`:

- Default theme: 32px rows.
- Compact theme: 26px rows, and `ContextMenuItemHeight` reserves 26.
- Compact theme with `RowHeight: 24`: 24px rows.
- A theme with `ControlHeight: 0`: 32px rows.
- A compact `DropdownMenu`: 26px rows.
- Labels stay 28px whatever the rows are.

The compact case fails without the change (`rows = {... Height:32} ..., want 26 high`).

Benchmarks, run interleaved (before, after, before, after, ...) 8 times each with `-benchmem` on an Apple M-series laptop. The machine was not idle, so treat differences of a few percent as noise:

| Benchmark | Before mean (min–max) | After mean (min–max) | Allocs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BenchmarkMenuOpen` (ui) | 2545 ns (2439–2686) | 2611 ns (2524–2833) | 0 → 0 |
| `BenchmarkDropdownMenuWithBackdrop` (components) | 535 ns (523–547) | 552 ns (532–596) | 0 → 0 |
| `BenchmarkContextMenuDescription` (components) | 416 ns (394–436) | 423 ns (396–439) | 0 → 0 |

The ranges overlap and nothing allocates. The change only swaps a constant for one field read.

## Visual evidence

- Changed: the rows of a context or dropdown menu in a compact or large theme. The default density does not change.
- Reach it by: any `ui.ContextMenu` on a page whose theme uses `gfx.LightTheme()` with `Metrics.WithDensity(gfx.DensityCompact)`.
- Evidence: the test above measures the rows; no screenshot attached.
- Protected by: `TestMenuRowsFollowTheThemeControlHeight`.

## Where the boundary sits

Framework capability. The theme already carries the density, and the menus are the one surface that ignored it.

## Cost

A program that doesn't change the density sees the same 32px rows. Each row reads one more metrics field.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#15.head: fix/menu-row-height-density

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#16.title: merge: bring upstream main (b63e4a0, delta updates) onto main
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#16.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#16.body:
## What this changes

Merges upstream `vivaui/viva` `main` at b63e4a0 into the fork's `main` (96a5af5). That brings in 36 upstream commits, including 27429b5, "feat(update): apply signed delta updates to the installed payload". Lithe needs it for delta updates in the desktop client.

The merge commit is 67313e5. Tag `v0.6.3` from upstream is pushed to the fork as well.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:

- `components/tooltip.go`: keeps the fork's theme `fontSize` and `padX`. Wraps with upstream's scratch-buffer `canvas.WrapLines(scratch[:0], label, fontSize, gfx.WeightRegular, maxWidth-2*padX, int(tooltip.viewport.Height))`, plus upstream's comment about keeping unbroken tokens whole.
- `components/scroll_area.go`: takes upstream's `HorizontalTrack`, which starts at `trackX` after the frozen band. Keeps the fork's thumb arguments: `scrollAreaThumb(geometry.HorizontalTrack, false, horizontalViewport, contentWidth-frozen, offsetX, maximumX, area.barInset(), area.minThumb())`.
- `internal/platform/darwin/native.m`: `setWindowTitle` now passes `_trafficLightScale` to `viva_place_traffic_lights`. Upstream added that argument, and the fork's title-change re-placement call predates it.
- `internal/platform/darwin/testdata/traffic_lights.m`: keeps both the fork's title-change assertions and upstream's scale assertion.
- `cmd/viva/templates/{scroll_area,tooltip,tree}.go.txt`: regenerated with `go run ./tools/componentgen`.

## Also merged: the macOS payload install fix (vivaui/viva#269)

`fix/update-darwin-payload-name` (bf0a714, on top of upstream b63e4a0) is merged into this branch as 0312f3d. It is the same branch as the upstream PR vivaui/viva#269.

`ApplyPatch` returns a directory named `viva-payload-*`, and `Install` copied the payload under that name. `stagedBundle` accepts only a `.app` entry, so a delta update on macOS always failed with "the archive holds no application bundle". The copy now takes the running bundle's name. `TestInstallStagesAnAppliedPatch` fails without the change and passes with it.

When upstream merges #269, the next sync merges it again with no conflict, since the same commit is already here.

## Merge with a merge commit, not a squash

`desktop/go.mod` in Lithe pins the head of this branch, 0312f3d, through `replace github.com/vivaui/viva => github.com/Lithe-IDEA/viva`. Merge this PR with a merge commit (or a fast-forward) so that 0312f3d stays on `main`. A squash would leave the pinned commit reachable only from this branch. Keep `sync/upstream-b63e4a0` and `fix/update-darwin-payload-name` until the merge lands.

## How it was verified

- [x] `go build ./...`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: `components`, `ui`, `update`, `internal/platform/darwin`, `tools/...`, and the `cmd/viva` recipe and feed tests pass.
  - 14 `cmd/viva` packaging tests fail with "built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0". A clean upstream checkout at b63e4a0 fails the same way on this machine (Xcode 27 SDK), so the merge did not cause it.
- [ ] a real window: the desktop client is checked against this commit in the Lithe PR.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#16.head: sync/upstream-b63e4a0

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#17.title: fix(windows): give wmSetTitle its own message number
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#17.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#17.body:
## What this changes

`wmSetTitle` in `internal/platform/windows/title_windows.go` moves from `0x8052` to `0x8053`, the next number that no private window message uses. The comment beside it now says why the number must differ from `wmSetSize`.

## Why

`main` does not compile for Windows since #16. Upstream added `wmSetSize = 0x8052` (`internal/platform/windows/window_windows.go:66`), and the fork's `Window.SetTitle` (#1) had already taken `0x8052` for `wmSetTitle`. #16 merged both without a text conflict, so the window procedure's `switch kind` now has two cases with the same value:

```
internal/platform/windows/window_windows.go:457:7: duplicate case wmSetTitle (constant 32850 of type uintptr) in expression switch
	internal/platform/windows/window_windows.go:451:7: previous case
```

The checks on #16 showed it: `cross-vet`, `native (windows-latest)`, `windows-arm64-text` and `windows-materials` failed. Lithe-IDEA's desktop client pins `main` (609dd47) through `replace` for delta updates, so its Windows build fails the same way.

Upstream has no `wmSetTitle` (#1 was not sent upstream), so this fix has no upstream counterpart.

The private messages the Windows package uses after this change: 0x8001–0x8007 (32769–32775), 0x8010–0x8012, 0x8016–0x8017 (32790–32791), 0x8040, 0x8050, 0x8051, 0x8052 (`wmSetSize`), 0x8053 (`wmSetTitle`).

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`: no files listed
- [x] `go vet ./...` on macOS (darwin/arm64): passes
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1`: not run locally. The change is in a `windows`-only file, which darwin tests do not build; this PR's Windows jobs run it.
- [x] platform vet: `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64|arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./internal/platform/windows/ ./app/... ./headless/... ./update/...` and `go build ./...` pass for both architectures. On 609dd47 without the change, the same build fails with the duplicate case above.
- [N/A] benchmarks: no paint, layout or input path changed
- [N/A] binary size: what links is unchanged
- [ ] a real window: not run; no Windows machine here. Setting a title after the window opens is the path to try on Windows.

## Where the boundary sits

A framework fix: the message numbers are internal to the Windows backend.

## Cost

Nothing.

## After merging

Lithe-IDEA bumps `replace github.com/vivaui/viva => github.com/Lithe-IDEA/viva` in `desktop/go.mod` to the commit this PR lands as on `main`.

Not part of this fix: `size`, `web` and `windows-materials` fail on upstream `main` too (b63e4a0 and 5b177b7), so they stay red here:

- `size`: `hello darwin/arm64` is 4172546 bytes, over the 3840000-byte limit.
- `web`: `TestApplyPatchChecksNameAndVersions` fails on js with `update: invalid feed: os "js" has no patch support`.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#18.title: feat(app): open a local file in the default browser
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#18.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#18.body:
## Problem

Lithe's HTML preview has an "Open in browser" button. Clicking it fails with `app: external URL must use http, https, or mailto`:

- The desktop builds a `file:` URL and calls `app.OpenURL`, which refuses that scheme on purpose.
- `app.OpenPath` would not be right either. It follows the `.html` file association, but Lithe has always sent pages to the default web browser (the `http` handler).

Viva has no call for that.

## Change

Adds `app.OpenPathInBrowser(path)`. On every platform it finds the default browser, the `http`/`https` handler, and gives it the local file:

- macOS: LaunchServices, then `open -a`.
- Windows: `AssocQueryStringW` for `http`, with the file's `file:` URL filled into the registered command.
- Linux: the desktop entry `xdg-settings` (or `xdg-mime`) names, with its `Exec` line expanded.

It also adds:

- `app.ErrNoBrowser` for a system with no default browser.
- `Driver.LastOpenedInBrowser()`, which records the call apart from `OpenPath`/`OpenURL`.

The full description, verification and cost are in the upstream PR: vivaui/viva#272.

## Branches

- `feat/open-path-in-browser`: one commit, `96873df`, branched from upstream `main` `b63e4a0`. It is the head of vivaui/viva#272.
- `lithe/open-path-in-browser-on-main` (this PR): the same commit cherry-picked onto fork `main` `609dd47`, as `09031a3`. #16 was squashed, so `b63e4a0` is not an ancestor of fork `main`. A PR from the upstream branch would show 231 files, and merging it conflicts in 7 files that this change does not touch.
- When upstream merges #272 and fork `main` next merges upstream, both copies of the change are identical, so the merge has nothing to resolve.

## Tests

- `go test ./app ./internal/platform ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/... -count=1` pass on this branch.
- gofmt is clean.
- `go vet` passes for darwin, linux/amd64, js/wasm and `-tags vivahead`.
- `GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/... ./app/` fails on fork `main` itself (`duplicate case wmSetTitle`, the #16 regression). With #17 merged into a throwaway branch on top of this one, it is clean. So #17 should go in first, or together with this.
- Real call on macOS: a page with spaces in its path opened in the default browser and the call returned nil.

New tests:

- `TestOpenPathInBrowserValidatesBeforeAskingTheSystem`
- `TestDriverRecordsOpenPathInBrowserAndStartsNothing`
- `TestFileURLIsOneWordABrowserResolvesBackToThePath`
- `TestBrowserCommandLineFillsInTheRegisteredCommand`
- `TestDesktopEntry*`
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#18.head: lithe/open-path-in-browser-on-main

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#19.title: fix(ui): TextArea 接收滚轮，内容超出时可滚动
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#19.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#19.body:
## 背景

多行输入框（`ui.TextArea`）不处理鼠标滚轮，只能随光标移动而滚动。Lithe 的本地历史规则列表因此无法用鼠标浏览超出高度的内容（Lithe 侧临时改为按行数撑开列表高度绕过，见 Lithe-IDEA #1938 之后的提交）。

## 改动

- `components/textarea.go`：`TextareaLayout.Wheel(event)`。指针在上次绘制的文本区域内时滚动它，并报告是否真的移动；已到达所需方向的末端、或内容不超出时返回 false。
- `ui/page.go`：`Page.Wheel` 在下拉框之后、其他滚动路由之前检查 TextArea。返回 false 时事件继续交给页面，即外层滚动区域滚动。
- `components/textarea_wheel_test.go`：覆盖区域外、顶端向上、正常向下、末端四种情况。

## 不在本 PR 范围内

- 未升级 Lithe 的 Viva 固定版本；合入后由维护者更新 `desktop/go.mod` 的 `replace`。
- 未向上游 vivaui/viva 提 PR。

## 验证

| 命令 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `go test ./components/ ./ui/ -count=1`（macOS） | 通过 |
| `go test ./components/ -run TestTextareaWheel -v` | PASS |
| `gofmt -l components ui` | 无输出 |

Lithe 桌面端的完整集成验证尚未在此分支上进行。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#20.title: fix(darwin): reopen 处理函数的 panic 交给 fault handler
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#20.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#20.body:
关联：1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1949（panic 全部进日志），配套 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1955；上游 PR vivaui/viva#288（同一提交，基于上游 main）。

## 问题

macOS 的 `deliverApplicationReopen` 恢复应用 reopen 处理函数的 panic 后，只写了诊断流的 `platform`/`reopen-panic` 和 stderr，没有调用 `platform.ReportFault`。因此 `app.SetFaultHandler` 装的处理函数收不到这次 panic。Lithe 的统一日志就是靠这个处理函数记录 `app.runtime.panic_interrupted` 的，所以这一处 panic 不会进 Lithe 日志。其他原生边界（AppKit 视图回调、剪贴板回调、Windows 窗口过程、COM 方法、钩子）都已经走 `ReportFault`。

## 改动

- `internal/platform/darwin/reopen_darwin.go`：recover 后调用 `platform.ReportFault("darwin: application reopen", value)`。应用的 fault handler 能收到消息和发生 panic 时的栈；诊断流在监听时会收到 `app`/`fault`（带 `where` 和 `stack`）。原生回退（`handled = false`）和 stderr 输出不变。
- 删除 `platform`/`reopen-panic` 事件（代码和 `docs/diagnostics.md` 中的一行），避免同一次 panic 报两遍。
- 新增测试 `TestApplicationReopenPanicReachesTheFaultHandler`，检查 `Where`、`Message` 和非空栈。

## 其余 recover 点的排查

`internal/platform` 下其余 `recover()` 都已调用 `platform.ReportFault`，或者不是应用故障：`runStateFor` 丢弃窗口释放后迟到的回调；`catchJS` 把 JS 异常作为 error 返回；fault 路径自身的保护。`internal/diag` 中的 recover 是诊断流自身的保护；`cmd/viva/vet.go` 是命令行工具。

## 验证

- `go test ./internal/platform/darwin ./internal/platform ./internal/diag ./app ./diagnostics`：macOS arm64 在 fork main（`4829f2b`）和上游 main（`f465bad`）两个基线上都通过。

Lithe 的 `go.mod` 固定版本由团队按流程升级，本 PR 不涉及。
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#20.head: lithe/reopen-fault-report

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#21.title: merge: bring upstream main (1fc84f6) onto main
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#21.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#21.body:
## What this changes

Merges vivaui/viva `main` (`1fc84f6`, 87 commits) into the fork's `main` (`4829f2b`), as a merge commit (`07550af`). This is the pre-release sync that Lithe's release rules require: after it, `git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main main` holds again.

**This PR must be merged with a merge commit, not squashed.** A squash would break the ancestry again, which is what happened with #16.

### Conflicts and how they were resolved

The rule: where a fork patch conflicts with upstream's approach, upstream wins. A fork hunk stays only when it carries a patch upstream does not have.

| Files | Taken | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 29 files: `update/*`, `tools/patchgen/*`, `cmd/viva` feed, help and package, Linux/Windows clipboard and cursor, `ui/table.go`, `components/dropdown_menu.go`, `internal/platform/contract.go`, `docs/updating.md`, website getting-started, README.zh-CN | upstream, whole file | Each carried only #16's older copy of an upstream change |
| `README.md`, `docs/conformance.md`, `app/driver_system.go` | upstream hunks | v0.6.4; the AppImage/rpm row; `driverPreventSleep` and `AwakeReasons` |
| `ui/frame.go`, `ui/page.go` | both | Upstream `PageConfig.Styles` sits next to the fork's `PageConfig.BarStyle` (#13). `Styles` covers Button, Checkbox, Switch and TextEntry, not scrollbars, so `BarStyle` stays |
| `components/scroll_area.go`, `components/tooltip.go` | fork hunks | The scrollbar geometry (#13) and the tooltip's padding and font size, which upstream does not have. The installer templates are regenerated with `go run ./tools/componentgen` |
| `internal/platform/darwin/testdata/traffic_lights.m` | fork hunk | The title-change test of #5 |

### Removed in favour of upstream

- `ui.MenuAt` (#3) and `TestMenuAtOpensAtThePointGiven`.
  - Upstream's `ui.ContextMenuAt(c, target, open, at, body)` does the same job: it opens a context menu at a point the application captured, with ContextMenu rows.
  - The fork's `MenuAt` no longer compiled against upstream's new `declareMenu`.
  - `ui/menu.go` is now byte-identical to upstream.
  - Lithe moves its four callers to `ContextMenuAt` in the PR that bumps its pin.

### Fork patches that remain fork-only

None of these has an upstream PR:

After this merge the fork differs from upstream `main` in 33 files (+840/−84). These patches are listed in Lithe's sync report.

## Why

Lithe's pinned fork commit must contain upstream `main` before each desktop release, with the fork's own patches on top. Fork `main` had drifted 87 commits behind, and its merge base with upstream was still `c1b073c`.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt -l` on the merged packages: empty

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#22.title: build: allow explicit cgo for native application packages
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#22.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#22.body:
## What this changes

Adds an explicit `--cgo` option shared by `viva build` and `viva package` for applications that link their own native libraries on Linux or Windows. The option retains the caller's compiler and cgo link flags. Linux/Windows still default to cgo disabled, including when the ambient environment has CGO_ENABLED=1; macOS keeps its required system bridge behavior, and the browser rejects the option.

Updates command help and the README, with regression tests for flag parsing, both target environments, unchanged caller inputs, and browser rejection.

## Why

An application linking a Rust static library stages its headers, archive and target compiler, then invokes `viva package`. The package builder currently overwrites CGO_ENABLED=1 with 0, excluding the application's C ABI files from compilation. Lithe's Linux amd64/arm64 AutoBuild reproduced this as `undefined: cancelOperation`; the same environment policy applies to Windows.

An explicit option preserves Viva's existing pure-Go portability default while allowing applications to own their native dependencies. It supplies no cross compiler and makes no claim that the resulting native dependencies are portable.

## How it was verified

- [x] Formatting checked with gofmt.
- [x] `go vet ./...` passed.
- [x] New `TestBuildCgoOptIn` fails before the fix because `-cgo` is unknown, and passes after it for Linux and Windows.
- [x] `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 go test ./cmd/viva -count=1 -timeout=120s` passed, including packaging tests.
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=120s` passed with the module's declared toolchain. The Go 1.27 run passed every package except existing macOS package fixtures that declare macOS 12 while Go 1.27 emits a macOS 13 minimum; that run is not reported as passing.
- `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...` and the arm64 equivalent both passed.
- Platform vet, visual evidence and real-window checks: N/A, no backend or UI change.
- Default application build arguments, tags and link flags remain unchanged; opting in intentionally links the application's chosen native libraries, whose size and system compatibility belong to the application.

## Where the boundary sits

This is a reusable build-tool option, with no knowledge of Lithe, Rust archive names or application protocols in the implementation. Applications retain responsibility for their compiler, ABI, library paths and supported systems.

## Cost

No runtime cost or new dependency for applications using the default. The additional option and environment branch live only in the Viva command-line tool.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#22.head: codex/explicit-cgo-packaging

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#23.title: fix(package): declare RPM shared-library runtime dependencies
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#23.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#23.body:
RPM packages currently require only `vulkan-loader`, `libxcb` and `cairo`. The Linux backend also opens Pango, Fontconfig, GObject and XCB extension libraries with `dlopen`; ELF dependency scanning cannot discover these names. On a minimal installation, the package can install without the libraries needed for text and window integration.

Declare the libraries as RPM shared-library capabilities, including `()(64bit)` for both supported targets. This also lets each RPM distribution select its own provider package instead of relying on Fedora package names. Optional GTK, IME and WebKit integrations stay optional; Debian-only manifest dependencies are still excluded from RPM.

The new regression packages both x86_64 and aarch64 RPMs and checks the emitted runtime requirements. It fails on the existing implementation and passes with the fix.

Validation: gofmt; `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 go vet ./...`; `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=120s`; Windows amd64 and arm64 cross-builds all pass. The toolchain follows this module's Go 1.26 baseline.

Reference: [SUSE RPM packaging guide](https://documentation.suse.com/sbp/systems-management/pdf/SBP-RPM-Packaging_en.pdf) describes shared-library providers such as `libc.so.6()(64bit)`.

This patch is based on the existing common commit 1fc84f6 so the fork can take this packaging fix without importing unrelated input-method changes from upstream.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#23.head: codex/rpm-runtime-libraries

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#24.title: feat(ui): hint when a List row's key is outside 0 to 2^31-1
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#24.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#24.body:
## Problem

In Lithe's settings window (Plugins → Installed), a click on any plugin row chose the last plugin. The bug was Lithe's: the rows were keyed by `int(fnv32a(id).Sum32())`, and all three hashes were past 2^31. Lithe fixed its keys in 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1974.

Viva works as documented here. `ListState.Key` names each row through `gfx.Index`, which documents that a negative number, or one of 2^31 or more, gets the zero name. The zero name is also item 0's name, so every row with such a key had one identity:

- A click on one of them was a click on all of them, and the row declared last was chosen.
- `RowID` was the same for all of them.

The hint was missing in two places. `ListState.Key`'s doc, which is what a List's user reads, did not give the range. And nothing was reported at run time, so the mistake was hard to trace back to the key.

This PR adds that hint. It is not a fix for a Viva defect.

## Change

- The `ListState.Key` doc gives the range, 0 to 2^31-1, and says to number the items rather than hash them.
- A key outside the range gets a hint: `ListState.key` panics with a message that names the fix. The page already gives the same kind of hint for duplicate keys. The check is one comparison, and the function still inlines (cost 78).
- `TreeState`'s copy of `key` is deleted, so a Tree uses `ListState.key` and gives the same hint.
- Tests: `TestListKeysAreItemNumbers` and `TestTreeKeyPastTheItemNumbersPanics`. Both fail without the change.

The full description, the alternatives considered, the benchmarks and the cost are in the upstream PR: vivaui/viva#298.

## Branches

- `fix/list-key-range`: one commit, `37d192a`, branched from upstream `main` `1fc84f6`. It is the head of vivaui/viva#298.
- `lithe/list-key-range-on-main` (this PR): the same commit cherry-picked onto fork `main` `429c811`, as `d9ee8b2`. The cherry-pick conflicted in `ui/tree.go`, because fork `main` has `disclosureSlot()` right above the deleted `TreeState.key`. The conflict is resolved by keeping `disclosureSlot()` and deleting `key`, so the change is the same as upstream's. Merging fork `main` into `fix/list-key-range` instead would have put fork-only commits into the upstream PR.
- When upstream merges #298 and fork `main` next merges upstream, both copies make the same change.

## Tests

On this branch, macOS 27 / arm64:

- `gofmt -l .` is clean, and `go vet ./ui ./components/...` passes.
- `go test ./... -count=1`: 90 packages pass. The only failure is `cmd/viva`: its 14 packaging tests say `the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0`. They fail the same way on upstream `1fc84f6` without this change, because of the local toolchain.
- `go build -gcflags=-m=2 ./ui` reports `can inline (*ListState).key with cost 78`.

Merging this PR, and moving Lithe's `desktop/go.mod` pin, are left to the maintainers.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#24.head: lithe/list-key-range-on-main

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#28.title: fix(update): resume an interrupted download
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#28.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#28.body:
## Problem

Lithe's update download started from zero again after any interruption. `update.Download` and `DownloadPatch` removed the temporary file on every failure, including a dropped connection. Nothing ended a connection that went silent either: the archive client has no total timeout, so a connection that stopped sending held the download until the window was closed.

Lithe also could not tell a cut-off patch download from a bad patch. Both made it fall back to the full archive, which is the larger download.

## Change

- **Resume.** An interrupted transfer keeps its bytes in a hidden `.viva-update-<sha256>.part` file in the download directory. The next call sends `Range: bytes=N-` for the rest.
  - A `200` starts the file over.
  - A `206` for another part, or a `416`, asks once more for the whole file.
  - The whole file is hashed again before it is kept. Kept bytes that fail the check are fetched once more from scratch.
- **`ErrInterrupted`.** It is returned for a failed connection, nothing arriving for a minute, `408`, `429` or `5xx`, or the end of `ctx` (the error wraps the context's error too).
- **A verified file is reused.** A directory that already holds it is returned without a request.
- **Calls for the same file take turns** within one process.
- **Tests:** 12 in `update/download_resume_test.go`.

The full description, the verification and the cost are in the upstream PR: vivaui/viva#324.

Lithe's side, in the Lithe PR that moves the pin:

- A cut-off patch is resumed, not replaced by the full archive.
- The update cache keeps one version.
- The marketplace plugin download gets the same resume and stall bound, in Lithe's own code.

## Branches

- `fix/update-download-resume`: one commit, `56a3522`, branched from upstream `main` `10c5b92`. It is the head of vivaui/viva#324.
- `lithe/update-download-resume-on-main` (this PR): the same commit cherry-picked onto fork `main` `97fdbdd`, as `00d4569`.
  - The cherry-pick applied without conflicts.
  - Merging fork `main` into `fix/update-download-resume` instead would have put fork-only commits into the upstream PR.
- When upstream merges #324 and fork `main` next merges upstream, both copies make the same change.

## Tests

On this branch, macOS 27 / arm64:

- `gofmt -l .` is clean. `go vet ./...` passes, and so do `GOOS=windows` and `GOOS=linux` `go vet ./update/ ./internal/... ./app/`.
- `go test ./... -count=1`: 90 packages pass. The only failure is `cmd/viva`: its 14 packaging tests say `the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0`. They fail the same way on fork `main` `97fdbdd` without this change, because of the local toolchain.
- `go test -race ./update/ -run TestDownload -count=20` passes.
- Lithe's desktop tests with this source: `desktop-go.sh test -race ./...`, 58 packages pass. They ran through a `go.work` replace whose `update` sources are byte-identical to this branch; only the new `416` test was missing there.

This PR needs merging before Lithe can use it: Lithe's updater now depends on `update.ErrInterrupted`. Merging it, and moving Lithe's `desktop/go.mod` pin to the merge result, are left to the maintainers.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#37.title: fix(ui): keep a ContextMenu's rows apart from its target's parts
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#37.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#37.body:
Upstream: vivaui/viva#341 (same branch).

This branch is based on upstream `aa89181`, which fork `main` already contains, so it merges cleanly. Lithe needs it so the first row of the editor and gutter context menus can be clicked. The Viva maintainers bump the `replace` pin in Lithe after this is merged.

## What this changes

An open `ContextMenu` now declares its rows, its backdrop and its scroll bar in a place of its own under the target's scope (`~menu`), instead of in the target's scope itself. The menu's state is still kept at the target's scope, so nothing changes for a closed menu. `ContextMenuAt` already had a scope of its own (bound to its `*bool`) and is unchanged.

## Why

`contextMenu` used `tree.Sub(id.Scope(), id.Name())` of the target as the menu's scope. `Control` hands out the same scope as the control's parts (`Handlers.Parts`), and a container given `Hit` has its children there too. So for a `ContextMenu` on a control with parts:

- row `i` was the identity `parts.At(3+i)`, the backdrop `parts.At(1)` and the bar `parts.At(2)`;
- `Page.controlOf` found the control for each of them (`h.parts == id.Scope()`) and routed the press to its `Pointer` as a press on that part;
- a control that handled the press returned `Handled`, the painter then delivered no click, and the row was never chosen.

We hit it in a text editor that names its scroll bars `parts.At(2)` and `parts.At(3)`: the first row of its context menu (Find) could never be chosen with the pointer, while the second row worked. The keyboard worked, because keys focus the row directly.

## How it was verified

On macOS 27 (arm64):

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: every package passes except `cmd/viva`, whose packaging tests fail on this machine with "the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0". They fail the same way on `aa89181` without this change, so the cause is the local toolchain, not this change.
- [ ] platform vet: no backend is touched.
- [x] benchmarks before and after: no existing benchmark declares a `ContextMenu`, so I ran a temporary one (not committed). It paints a page of 200 targets, each with a closed `ContextMenu`, `-count 6`, on `aa89181` and on this branch: about 113 µs/op both times, 0 allocs/op. `BenchmarkMenuOpen` and `BenchmarkTree` also show no change. A first version that made the `~menu` scope on every paint cost about 5% on that page, which is why the scope is now made only while the menu is open.
- [ ] stripped binary size: no new links.
- [x] a real window: the same fix, applied to the application that found it (Lithe), makes the first row of its editor menu clickable in its headless UI tests.

`TestControlContextMenuIsNotItsParts` (in `ui/control_parts_test.go`) puts a `ContextMenu` on the five-star rating `Control` and checks that:

- each of the menu's three rows can be chosen with the pointer;
- a click outside the menu closes it without pressing a star;
- a repaint with the menu open allocates nothing.

Without the fix it fails at once with `a click on Clear chose [], menu shown true`, because the first row's press went to star 4.

## Where the boundary sits

Framework capability: it fixes how `ContextMenu` names what it declares. There is no product behaviour.

## Cost

Nothing for a closed menu. An open context menu does one more interned scope lookup per paint.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#37.head: fix/context-menu-scope

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#40.title: fix(ui): keep the wheel over a Popover, Dialog or modal Drawer in the panel
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#40.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#40.body:
## What this changes

A wheel over an open Popover's panel, a Dialog or a modal Drawer is now the panel's:

- `view.Wheel` looks for the topmost such panel under the pointer (`frame.wheelPanel`, the floats from the last painted down) and offers the wheel only to the ScrollAreas declared inside it (`frame.wheelArea`). An event none of them can use stops at the panel, handled.
- `Page.Wheel` applies the same rule to everything else it routes: self-scrolling Tables (`tableRoute.root`), TextAreas (`fieldEntry.box`) and the sideways wheel of a List with RowWidth (`listWheelX` takes the panel). Inside a panel they still scroll; under it they do not. Over a panel, the event no longer falls through to `Config.OnScroll`, unless the pointer is over a ScrollAt area, whose wheel stays the application's, as before.
- Beside a Popover the page scrolls as before: a Popover is not modal. A non-modal Drawer and an application's `Overlay` (whose docs leave the wheel to the application) keep the routing they had.

## Why

`view.Wheel` walked the nodes from the last declared to the first and gave the wheel to the first ScrollArea under the pointer that could move, whatever was painted on top of it. A Popover that hangs off a title bar button is declared before the page under it, so in Lithe, scrolling the project list in the title bar's project popover scrolled the project tree underneath first. Only once the tree reached its end did the list move. Over the panel's padding, or with its list at its end, the wheel went through to the tree. The same happened under a Modal's scrim, and to a Table, a TextArea or a List's sideways wheel under any of these panels.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: everything passes except the `cmd/viva` packaging tests, which fail identically on `059256b` without this change on this machine ("the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0"; the macOS 27 SDK's deployment target). `ui`, `app` and `components` also pass merged onto the latest upstream `main` (`5534f58`).
- [x] platform vet: `go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`, and `GOOS=windows` / `GOOS=linux` `go vet ./internal/... ./app/`
- [x] benchmarks before and after: there is no wheel benchmark, so a throwaway one (not committed) called `view.Wheel` on a page of ten ScrollAreas of 50 rows each, with no panel open (Apple M4, `-count=5`, interleaved): before 226–236 ns/op, after 239–251 ns/op, 0 allocs both. The extra ~10–15 ns is the search for a panel among the floats. With a panel open, the search starts at the panel's root, so it scans fewer nodes.
- [ ] stripped binary size: not affected (no new dependencies)
- [ ] a real window: not run; the tests below drive the page through `app.Driver.Scroll`

New tests in `ui/popover_wheel_test.go`, each failing without the change:

- `TestAWheelOverAPopoverStaysInThePanel`: a Popover declared before a page ScrollArea under it. The wheel scrolls the panel's list and not the page. At the list's end and over the panel's padding the page stays put. Beside the panel the page scrolls.
- `TestATableInAPopoverTakesTheWheelAndTheTableUnderItDoesNot`: a self-scrolling Table in a Popover takes the wheel, and the Table under the panel does not, even past the panel table's end. Beside the panel the page's Table scrolls.
- `TestAWheelOverAModalLeavesThePageUnderIt`: with a Modal open, a wheel over its surface or its scrim does not scroll the page.

## Where the boundary sits

Framework capability: which element the wheel reaches is the page's routing, and a panel Viva paints over the page is opaque to presses (`Canvas.Block`) already. This makes it opaque to the wheel the same way.

## Upstream

The same branch is proposed upstream as vivaui/viva#349.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#40.head: fix/popover-wheel-stays-in-panel

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#42.title: fix(components): carry a tooltip's border around its arrow
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#42.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#42.body: ## What this changes A bordered `TooltipStyle` now outlines the arrow as well as the body: - `Tooltip.Paint` paints a border-colored arrow before the body, with both slanted edges pushed outward by `BorderSize`, and paints the body-colored arrow last. The outline runs on around the arrow at the border's width. - `paintArrow` takes the fill color and how far to grow the slanted edges. The base keeps its `tooltipArrowInset` overlap with the body, so the border arrow joins the ring without a seam. - A style without a border paints the single body-colored arrow it did before. - `cmd/viva/templates/tooltip.go.txt` is regenerated with `go run ./tools/componentgen`. ## Why A bordered tooltip drew its ring around the body only. The arrow, filled with the body color, sits over the ring where it leaves the body. So the outline broke at the arrow, and a light arrow melted into a light window behind it. In Lithe, the light theme's white bordered tooltip showed this on every ⓘ. Before (left) and after (right), zoomed in on a top-placed arrow: All four sides after the change, with a white tooltip and a 1 pt light gray border on a light page: The same page before the change: [viva-arrow.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/c15011a8cf2ff25a5f8c894285457252f201591f/docs/assets/tooltip-unified-style/before/viva-arrow.png). ## How it was verified - [x] `gofmt -l .` is empty - [x] `go vet ./...` - [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: everything passes except the 14 `cmd/viva` packaging tests. They fail the same way on `213c78a` without this change on this machine ("the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0", from the macOS 27 SDK's deployment target). - [x] platform vet: `go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`, `GOOS=windows` / `GOOS=linux` `go vet ./internal/... ./app/`, and `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64|arm64 go build ./...` - [x] benchmarks: a throwaway benchmark (not committed) painted a bordered tooltip (Apple M4, `-count=10`). Before: 149.9–160.6 ns/op (mean 153.3). After: 170.5–172.5 ns/op (mean 171.5). Both 0 allocs. The extra ~18 ns is the second triangle and one `math.Hypot`, paid only by a bordered style. The existing `BenchmarkTooltipLongUnbrokenLabel` stays the same (mean 3750 → 3720 ns/op). - [ ] stripped binary size: not affected (no new dependencies) - [ ] a real window: not run. The screenshots above come from a headless test (not committed) that paints the four sides. New test `TestTooltipBorderOutlinesTheArrow` in `components/tooltip_style_test.go` fails without the change (`side 0 painted 1 arrow triangles, want the border arrow and the body arrow`). For every side it checks that: - the border arrow is painted under the body and the body arrow over it; - the border arrow's base keeps the inset into the body; - each body-arrow corner sits exactly `BorderSize` inside the border arrow's slanted edges. ## Where the boundary sits This is a framework capability. `TooltipStyle.Border` and `BorderSize` are Viva's, and the arrow is part of the tooltip Viva paints. An application cannot outline the arrow from outside. ## Upstream `TooltipStyle` exists upstream only in vivaui/viva#305, so this commit cannot go onto upstream `main` on its own. The same fix is pushed to #305's branch (`codex/component-theme-hooks`, commit `f34e502`). This PR's branch is a cherry-pick of it onto the fork's `main` (`213c78a`), so the commits differ but the change is the same. Lithe no longer gives its tooltips a border: the change that unifies the three windows' tooltip (1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2170) uses a dark tooltip without one. So Lithe does not depend on this fix, and the Viva pin is left to a later sync.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#45.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#45.body:
## Problem

A single large wheel event can leave a short-row List blank at the end. List picks the visible rows from the newly measured extent while the scroll offset still belongs to the previous estimate.

## Change

Clamp the scroll offset before selecting the visible range. Keep the pinned/follow-to-end branch unchanged. Add a headless 400 × 24 px regression which fails before the fix and passes after it. This is required by the compact grouped search results in 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2199.

The same patch is submitted upstream: https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/357.

## Validation

- `go test ./ui ./base -race -count=1`: passed on macOS arm64 against the fork base.
- Upstream branch `go vet ./...`: passed.
- Upstream `go test ./... -count=1`: all packages except `cmd/viva` passed. Its packaging fixture expects macOS 12.0 while this machine links 13.0; setting `MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0` did not resolve that fixture mismatch.
- BenchmarkList100k: median 19.47 µs before / 18.66 µs after, 0 allocs/op (3 short 100-iteration samples on Apple M4). No observed regression; no speedup claim.
- Windows native UI remains unverified.

This PR contains only the list fix; upstream synchronization and updating Lithe's Viva pin are separate release prerequisites.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#5.title: darwin: keep the traffic lights centered when the title changes
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#5.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#5.body:
## What this changes

`setWindowTitle:` on macOS places the traffic lights again after it sets the window title, when the window has a custom titlebar.

## Why

A new title makes AppKit lay the titlebar out again. During that layout AppKit moves the zoom button back to the system's height, and it posts no `NSViewFrameDidChangeNotification` for that last move, so `keepTrafficLightsCentered` never sees it. In a custom titlebar taller than the system's, the green button ends up above the red and yellow ones until the next resize. Lithe IDE (1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1799) sets the title when a project opens (`Window.SetTitle`, #1), so its 40 pt titlebar showed the green button 4 pt higher than the other two.

The same layout leaves the close and minimize buttons, and the container, where Viva put them. Only the zoom button moves without a notification.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`: no Go file changed.
- [x] `go vet ./internal/platform/darwin` and `go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`
- [x] `go test ./internal/platform/darwin ./app/... ./headless/... -count=1`: all pass.
  - Without the fix, `TestNativeTrafficLightPlacementAndWindowLevel` fails with `traffic light 2 is at y=377.00, the close button at 375.00 after the title changed`.
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1`: not run in full; only the packages above.
- [ ] benchmarks: no paint, layout or input path changed.
- [x] a real window on macOS 27 (Darwin 27.3), Apple Silicon.
  - A standalone AppKit window built the way Viva builds a custom titlebar: 40 pt strip, ordered front off screen.
  - Before the fix the zoom button's center is 16 pt below the top after the title changes, and the other two are at 20 pt.
  - Placing the buttons right after the title change holds them at 20 pt, also after the run loop turns and after the window becomes key.

## Visual evidence

- Changed: the traffic lights of a `WindowCustomTitlebar` window with `TitlebarHeight` above 28, after `Window.SetTitle`.
- Reach it by: open such a window and call `SetTitle` once it is shown.
- On: macOS 27.
- Protected by: the "after the title changed" checks in `internal/platform/darwin/testdata/traffic_lights.m`.

## Where the boundary sits

Framework. It is the macOS backend's own titlebar placement.

## Cost

Nothing for windows without a custom titlebar. With one, a title change runs `viva_place_traffic_lights`, which is idempotent and touches three views.

## Upstream

vivaui/viva has no `Window.SetTitle` yet (#1 was not proposed upstream), so this fix cannot go upstream on its own. It belongs with `SetTitle` when that is proposed.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#5.head: fix/title-keeps-traffic-lights

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#50.title: fix(platform): draw lines wider than a texture from a window of them on Windows and Linux
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#50.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#50.body:
Upstream: vivaui/viva#375 (the same commit on upstream `main` `54981a3c`). This branch is that commit cherry-picked onto the fork's `main` (`d354e3c8`). None of the 22 files it changes differ between the two bases. On this branch: `go build ./...`, `go test ./internal/platform/... ./ui/... ./app/...` on macOS, and `go vet ./internal/platform/... ./app/` for windows and linux on amd64 and arm64 all pass.

## What this changes

A text label wider than the 16384 device pixels a texture holds, a monospaced or run-colored line included, is now drawn on Windows and Linux from a window of it, as macOS has drawn it since #178. A label no texture can hold is left undrawn instead of failing the frame.

- `internal/platform` has the rule every renderer uses:
  - `LabelTextureLimit`/`LabelTexturePixels` name the bound the backends already used.
  - `LabelTextureWidth(height)` is the widest texture a label of that height gets. `LabelTextureFits` tests a size against it without a division, since it is asked of every label every frame.
  - `WideLabelWindow` is the window `viva_label_window` in `native.m` chooses: the visible columns, with as much margin on each side as they are wide, kept while a scroll stays inside the texture. `WideTextLabelWindow` gets the visible columns from the viewport and the label's clip.
  - `ShiftGridSpans` moves a grid line's ClearType spans onto the window.
  - No existing function changed, so darwin is untouched.
- Windows:
  - `labelTexture.window` takes the target's width. A label one texture holds pays a `LabelTextureFits` test and keeps the window it had before. A wider line of any kind gets the wide window.
  - `grid` and `gridLCD` draw their pieces from `-skip`, the ClearType spans are planned in the line's columns and shifted onto the texture, and the per-span cut adds `label.skip`.
  - The Direct2D batch and the label picture key take the same window. `needsRaster` gathers the conditions `draw` and `prepareLabels` tested separately.
  - `rasterize` leaves a label without a texture instead of returning `label texture exceeds bounded size`.
- Linux Vulkan: `vulkanLabelTexture` keeps the window (`skip`, `wide`) and a `dropped` flag. `needsUpload` rasterizes a wide line again only when the visible columns leave its texture. A label scrolled out of view, or too tall for any texture, is not rasterized again every frame. `textViewport` is the frame's content width.
- Linux CPU:
  - `textWindow` picks the same window. The soft scene draws a wide line again only when that window moves, and `placeLabel` offsets the picture by `skip`.
  - Cairo draws the line translated by `-skip`. `drawRuns` skips runs outside the window, and of a printable ASCII run draws only the cells in it, plus one either side for an italic's overhang.

The skip is a whole number of device columns, so every glyph keeps the phase it has in the whole line.

## Why

Lithe (1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2227) crashed on Windows when a language server's log was opened. The log shows lines unwrapped, and one of 4096 characters at 8 logical pixels a cell and 150% is 49152 device pixels wide. The Windows renderer rasterized a Mono or Runs label whole, so the frame returned `rasterize label N: windows: label texture exceeds bounded size`, and the window loop stopped drawing anything again. `textServices.draw` on Linux had the same bound and the same failure. #178 fixed this for Metal only.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...` on macOS: clean apart from the existing `didModifyRange:` deprecation warning in `native.m`.
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1` on macOS (Apple Silicon): 126 packages pass, `internal/platform/darwin` included. `cmd/viva` fails identically on `54981a3c` without this change:
  - The packaging tests fail with "the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0", from the macOS 27 SDK's deployment target.
  - `TestGeneratedRecipesAreCurrent` and `TestInstalledRecipesMatchReferenceSource` fail because componentgen reports `cmd/viva/templates/select.go.txt` as stale on `main`.
- [x] platform vet: `GOOS=windows` and `GOOS=linux`, `GOARCH=amd64` and `arm64`, `go vet ./internal/platform/... ./app/`. `GOOS=windows go build ./...` for amd64 and arm64.
- [x] Windows: run on a real Windows 11 machine (AMD64, NT 10.0.26300, D3D11 hardware device, Go 1.26.3) over SSH.
  - The new tests pass.
  - The whole `internal/platform/windows` package: 246 pass. The same 25 fail before and after this change: Backdrop, Resize, Redraw, FileDrop, SetTitle and similar tests, which need the interactive desktop an SSH session does not have.
  - On `54981a3c`, `TestWideMonoLineIsDrawnFromAWindowOfIt` and `TestLabelNoTextureHoldsDoesNotFailTheFrame`, written against the API there, fail with `rasterize label 0: windows: label texture exceeds bounded size`.
- [x] Linux: a native arm64 Ubuntu 24.04 container, with Mesa lavapipe for Vulkan and Pango/Cairo for the CPU renderer.
  - The new tests pass on both renderers.
  - The whole `internal/platform/linux` package: 390 pass before and 394 after; the 4 extra are the new tests. One test fails in both, `TestEnginePassesTheTextEngineContract`, on the container's fonts.
  - `TestSetTitle*` were skipped in both runs: they dereference a nil X connection without a display.
  - The new Linux tests use the window and do not build on `54981a3c`. There, `textServices.draw` returns `linux: label texture exceeds bounded size` for the same line.
- [x] benchmarks before and after. Base and change were interleaved: 5 rounds, `-benchtime 500ms`. Median ns/op. allocs/op are the same before and after, except `PageSwitch`, whose allocations vary from run to run on both sides (batched 1455–1461 before and 1452–1478 after, per-label 1237–1419 before and 1339–1421 after):

  | Windows, Ryzen 7 9800X3D | before | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | RendererUnchangedFrame | 1.0 | 1.0 |
  | LabelRasterize/latin | 41555 | 39278 |
  | LabelRasterize/cjk | 42854 | 40867 |
  | GridRasterize/grayscale | 149899 | 147830 |
  | GridRasterize/cleartype | 96938 | 95213 |
  | FixedPitchLine/hinted=true | 27894 | 27105 |
  | TerminalScreenUnchanged | 945745 | 921968 |
  | ScrollingTerminalRows/identity | 336504 | 338249 |
  | ScrollingTerminalRows/positional | 9082821 | 8906632 |
  | PageSwitch/batched | 3388763 | 3359405 |
  | PageSwitch/per-label | 6969658 | 7156273 |
  | LabelPicturePageSwitch/cache=true/warm=true | 13738 | 13960 |
  | LabelPicturePageSwitch/cache=false/warm=false | 9047556 | 9119502 |

  | Linux arm64 container | before | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | RasterizeSentence/grayscale | 30395 | 28711 |
  | RasterizeSentence/lcd | 38848 | 38062 |
  | GridRasterize/grayscale | 611531 | 616730 |
  | GridRasterize/lcd | 633627 | 630513 |

  All rows are within the runs' spread. A first version computed the wide window for every label every frame and cost `LabelPicturePageSwitch/cache=true/warm=true` 8%. The ordinary label's early test (`LabelTextureFits`, no division) brought that back.
- [ ] stripped binary size: not measured. Nothing new links; the change is internal code.
- [ ] a real window: no interactive window. The renderers were driven offscreen on the machines above.

New tests:

- `internal/platform`:
  - `TestLabelTextureWidthKeepsTheTextureBounded` also checks that `LabelTextureFits` agrees with `LabelTextureWidth` at every edge.
  - `TestLabelVisibleColumnsCutsTheClipToTheLabel`, `TestWideLabelWindowKeepsTheVisibleColumnsWithAMargin`, `TestWideTextLabelWindowFollowsTheViewportAndTheClip` and `TestShiftGridSpansMovesTheColumnsOntoTheWindow` cover the rule.
- Windows:
  - `TestWideLabelWindowFollowsTheViewport`: a scroll inside the texture keeps it, and one past it windows again.
  - `TestWideMonoLineWindowHoldsThePixelsOfTheLine`: a window's rasterized pixels are byte for byte the pixels of the start of the line at the same columns. This covers ClearType on and off, without and with runs, unscrolled and 1000 characters scrolled.
  - `TestWideMonoLineIsDrawnFromAWindowOfIt`: the same through the whole renderer.
  - `TestLabelNoTextureHoldsDoesNotFailTheFrame`.
- Linux:
  - `TestVulkanWideLabelWindowFollowsTheViewport`.
  - `TestWideMonoLineIsDrawnFromAWindowOfIt`, run on Vulkan and CPU, opaque and transparent, without and with runs.
  - `TestSoftSceneDrawsAWideLineFromWhatTheCanvasShows`: after each scroll, the live canvas is byte for byte a fresh paint.
  - `TestLabelNoTextureHoldsDoesNotFailTheFrame`.

On Windows, `TestWideMonoLineIsDrawnFromAWindowOfIt` allows one level per channel and the Linux one does not:

- The rasterized textures are identical, which `TestWideMonoLineWindowHoldsThePixelsOfTheLine` checks exactly.
- The D3D11 text sampler is `MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR`. A quad that starts left of the target reaches the same texel centres through a different interpolation, and the hardware's 8-bit filter weights can mix 1/256 of a neighbouring texel in.
- That already happens upstream for any label texture that starts off-screen. A glyph moved by a device pixel differs by far more than one level.

## Visual evidence

- Changed: a monospaced line wider than 16384 device pixels, such as an unwrapped log line of 4096 characters at 150%. Before, the window stopped drawing on Windows and Linux. Now the line is drawn and scrolls.
- Reach it by: a `Text` with `Mono` and a 4096-character value, in a horizontally scrolling area at 150%.
- Evidence: the pixel comparisons above. There is no screenshot, because the tests compare against the start of the same line, which one texture holds.
- On: Windows 11 at 150%, D3D11 offscreen. Linux at 150%, lavapipe and CPU offscreen.
- Protected by: `TestWideMonoLineIsDrawnFromAWindowOfIt` (Windows and Linux) and `TestWideMonoLineWindowHoldsThePixelsOfTheLine` (Windows).

## Where the boundary sits

Framework capability. The texture bound belongs to Viva's renderers, and any application that shows a long line reaches it. macOS already handles it in `native.m`, and this gives Windows and Linux the same window rule from one shared function.

## Cost

Nothing for a label one texture holds. It pays one `LabelTextureFits` comparison per frame, with no division and no allocation, and keeps the window and texture it had. The benchmarks above are unchanged within their spread.
