Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#55.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#55.body:
## 关联上游 PR

- 上游 [vivaui/viva#349](https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/349)

## 改动类型

- [x] fix
- [ ] feat
- [ ] docs
- [ ] release

## 改动内容

把上游 PR #349 的面板滚轮路由修复同步到 Lithe Viva fork `main`：Popover、Dialog、AlertDialog、modal Drawer 内的滚轮事件会停留在面板内；non-modal Drawer 只在内容区域内拦截；Table、TextArea 和横向 List 继续使用面板内路由；ScrollAt 保留宿主回调所有权。

同时把修复移植到 fork 当前基线的 base 引擎，并解决与 fork 现有改动的冲突：保留 fork 的树 Disclosure、滚动条样式和 Tooltip 定制，保留上游的 TooltipDelay、SelectedColor、Dock 测试更新和最新组件 API。合并后同步运行 componentgen，确保安装器模板与 components 源文件一致。

## 验证

- `go test ./ui ./base ./components ./app ./gfx -count=1 -timeout=180s`
- `go test ./cmd/viva -run '^Test(InstalledRecipesMatchReferenceSource|GeneratedRecipesAreCurrent)$' -count=1 -timeout=90s`
- `go test ./ui ./base -run 'Test(.*(Wheel|ScrollAt|Sideways|Drawer|RowWidth)|ScrollingAllocatesNothingOnceWarm)' -count=1 -timeout=150s`

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#56.title: fix(markdown): decode inline character references
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#56.author: Mucheen
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#56.body:
Carries the Markdown fix from [vivaui/viva#398](https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/398) on the current fork main.

## What this changes

Decode complete named, decimal, and hexadecimal character references in Markdown inline text. Keep the decoded characters in the surrounding text span so the line can measure and wrap them together. Code spans, fenced code, escaped ampersands, and malformed references keep their literal text.

## Why

Language servers can use ` ` to preserve indentation in Markdown documentation. For example, Pyrefly's hover for Python's `re` module includes runs of ` ` before regular expression syntax examples. Viva rendered each reference as six visible characters, widening the popup and introducing unnecessary line breaks.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt -l` across tracked Go files, `git diff --check`, and `go vet ./...`
- [x] Confirmed the new parser test fails before the fix and passes afterward. `go test -race ./markdown ./components ./ui/markdown -count=1 -timeout=75s` passes on macOS ARM64.
- [x] `go test -p=4 ./... -count=1 -timeout=3m` passes on macOS ARM64 with Go 1.26.10, covering 127 packages. Go 1.27.4 raised the packaging deployment target to macOS 13.0 against 12.0 fixtures on the unchanged baseline as well.
- [x] Lithe's 12 existing hover tests and four headless screenshot cases pass with the patch applied to its pinned Viva revision.
- [ ] Native window and Windows interaction checks

## Visual evidence

- Changed area is the editor's Markdown hover for the `re` token in `import re`.
- To reproduce in Viva, pass `    A|B   Matches A or B.` to `markdown.Document.Parse` and draw it with `components.MarkdownView`. The Lithe screenshots use the same path with a synthetic hover response.
- Captured on macOS ARM64 using `vivahead`, light and dark, English and Simplified Chinese, 1100 × 670 logical pixels at 2× scale. [Before, light](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/blob/1e32739cda9209efda0e9558ca9e7de3a762620b/before/light-en.png) · [After, light](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/blob/1e32739cda9209efda0e9558ca9e7de3a762620b/after/light-en.png) · [All eight screenshots](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/tree/1e32739cda9209efda0e9558ca9e7de3a762620b)
- `TestInlineCharacterReferences` covers indentation, numeric and named references, escaped and malformed inputs, one-pass decoding, emphasis and link labels, and literal text in code.

## Where the boundary sits

Decoding is owned by Viva's Markdown reader. Applications provide Markdown and consume its text spans without needing to add their own substitutions.

## Cost

On Apple M5, `BenchmarkParse` measured a median 14.9 to 15.0 µs per operation across five samples, with 0 allocations per operation in both cases. Character reference lookahead is bounded by the longest supported name. Ordinary spans still reuse slices of the source. The standard library entity table adds 110,864 bytes to a stripped macOS ARM64 binary that only parses and prints Markdown spans.

The fork branch also passes `go test ./markdown ./components ./ui/markdown -count=1` on macOS ARM64.

The advisory `size` job already exceeds the 3,840,000-byte ceiling for `hello darwin/arm64` on fork `main`. The CI runs reported 4,393,330 bytes on `main` and 4,459,378 bytes on this branch. [Baseline size job](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/44977566976/job/137070792826) · [Patch size job](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/45004574546/job/137153210545)

Lithe tested this branch in a temporary module and adapted the argument order of 16 `ui.PopoverWith` calls for the newer fork API. All 12 hover tests and the four screenshot cases passed. The Lithe dependency update will use a fork `main` commit.

## Review follow-up

Go's standard library omits `≪⃒` and `≫⃒` because their UTF-8 replacements are longer than the source. The follow-up fills those two mappings and adds a failing-then-passing regression for adjacent references. All 2,125 semicolon-terminated names and three boundary cases passed with Go 1.26.10 and 1.27.4. The twelve desktop hover tests and four headless screenshot cases also passed again on the updated fork candidate.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#56.head: codex/markdown-character-references-fork

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#57.title: merge: sync upstream main (68be843c) into the fork
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#57.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#57.body:
发布 Lithe 桌面端 0.8.15 前的上游同步。把 `vivaui/viva` main（`68be843c`）合进 fork `main`（`103c1952`），带来 64 个上游提交。

## 上游带来的主要变化

- **文本与编辑器**：行引擎在浏览器和其他平台之间共用（`4472fc85`），编辑器文本改为 UTF-8 叶子节点、通过 store 访问 runes（`59c733f2`、`b108bb19`），CodeEditor 只对编辑触及的行重新布局（`932c9aae`），双向文字的字形几何在语法着色、换行和制表符下保持（`68be843c`、`ee7ba130`、`e320ba5d`），CodeEditor 的定位不再切断字素簇（`302faef4`）。
- **触摸与移动端**：手指事件（点按放置光标、长按选词、惯性滑动、过界回弹）、Android 与 iOS 后端、VoiceOver 无障碍树。
- **渲染与性能**：Vulkan 渲染器移出 Linux 后端（`6d2fd9b0`），每个窗口共用一个 Vulkan 设备，标签图像内存分块子分配，输入区域只在路由里保存一份。
- **新 API**：`base.Hide`/`base.Show`（`05804abe`）、`base.From` 按窗口或容器宽度响应（`a96c6733`）、`Config.CaptureMenuKeys`（`0f959e5c`，菜单捕获按键时保留 IME 组字）。
- **打包**：一组 dmg 修复（重复 detach、服务丢失暂存目录、镜像构建不再暴露可安装的 app）。

## 冲突与解决

两处冲突，都是上游和我们改到同一段代码，但解决的是不同问题，所以两边都保留；没有出现「上游用另一种做法解决了同一个问题」的情况。

| 文件 | 冲突 | 解决 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app/painter.go` | 上游在 painter 的初始化列表里加了 `captureMenuKeys`，我们这一侧有 fork 独有的 `onFocusLost` | 取上游的列表，补回 `onFocusLost`。`painter` 结构体、`focusLostHandler` 和 `focusLost` 的改动已自动合并，无需调整。 |
| `base/scroll.go` | 上游给 `ScrollState` 加了手指过界回弹的 `pull`/`touching`/`pullAt`，并在 `wheelArea` 末尾加了「手指滚不动时交给最内层还能滚的区域」的兜底；我们这一侧有 fork 独有的 `barStyle`（按区域覆盖滚动条几何）和 `panel` 限制（滚轮不穿透 Popover、Dialog、模态 Drawer） | 字段两边都保留。上游的兜底分支并入我们的双返回值签名，并且同样遵守 `panel` 限制和 `within` 判断——否则手指在浮层上滚到底会带动底下的页面，正是 fork #40 要修的问题。`ScrollPhaseEnd` 的提前返回补上 `manual` 返回值。 |

## 我们的补丁

fork `main` 上没有待合入的 PR（`gh pr list --repo Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva --state open` 为空），所有补丁都已经在 `main` 上，这次 merge 全部保留，没有需要 revert 的。

`a105ef83 fix(markdown): decode inline character references` 是从上游 `9707cce3` cherry-pick 来的，上游以 `148d6dcb` 合入；这次 merge 自动合并，没有冲突。

## 验证

| 命令 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `go build ./...`（darwin/arm64） | 通过 |
| `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...`、`GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build ./...` | 都通过 |
| `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...` | 通过 |
| `go test ./base/ ./app/ ./ui/ ./components/ ./markdown/ ./gfx/` | 全部通过 |
| `go test ./...` | 132 个包通过。`cmd/viva` 的 dmg 与签名测试在本机失败：`the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0`。在上游 `origin/main` 上直接跑同一个测试也是同样的失败，是本机 Xcode SDK 的部署目标造成的，与这次同步无关。 |

`go test ./...` 还报了 `build` 包编译失败：那是本机 `build/` 目录（`.gitignore` 忽略）里一个上次会话留下的未跟踪基准文件 `pr349_wheel_bench_test.go`，不在仓库里，也不随这次同步改变。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#58.title: merge: sync upstream main (471ea7ab) into fork
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#58.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#58.body:
## What this changes

Merges `upstream/main` (`471ea7ab`: `refactor: move the phone backends to the mobile branch`, including upstream `v0.6.7` and `ui/textview` `7ea39847`) into `sync/upstream-471ea7ab` (based on `origin/main` `3c6c4608`), keeping merge-commit history (`git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD`).

- **Conflict resolution (upstream wins, 12 files)**:
  - `ui/textview/{cells.go,paint.go,rows.go,selection.go,selection_test.go,view.go,view_test.go}`: took `upstream/main` (`ui/textview` from upstream PR #337, which wraps un-scrolled/un-wrapped views in `ui.Column(c)` and removes `c.Key("menu")` from `ui.ContextMenuAt` on `ui/textview/view.go:311`). `git diff upstream/main -- ui/textview/` is empty.
  - `docs/maintaining-controls.md`, `docs/skills/building-with-viva/SKILL.md`, `website/content/guides/{en,zh}/components.md`: took `upstream/main` textview guide sections.
  - `cmd/viva/initfiles/AGENTS.md.txt`: took `upstream/main` updates (`textview`, `Italic`, `Strike`) while retaining the fork-only `ScrollBar.Bars` / `PageConfig.BarStyle` and `Theme.Tooltip` entries required by `base/guide_test.go`.
- Synced missing upstream tag `v0.6.7` (`22984e8b`) to `origin` without creating any GitHub Releases.

## Why

Pinned fork commit `3c6c4608` carries the older fork `ui/textview/view.go:311` calling `ui.ContextMenuAt(c.Key("menu"), ...)` while `base.ContextMenuAt` returns early when `!*open` without consuming `c.Key("menu")`, causing `-tags dev` (`base/attrcheck_dev.go`) attribute checks in Lithe-IDEA to panic (`Key "menu" was given to a Column`) after any `outputList`. Upstream `vivaui/viva` already fixed this in `7ea39847`.

## How it was verified

On `b7ac8d73` (macOS arm64):
- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"` (clean)
- [x] `go vet ./...` and `go vet -tags dev ./...` (passed)
- [x] `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...` and `GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build ./...` (passed)
- [x] `go test ./base ./ui/... -count=1` and `go test -tags dev ./base ./ui/... -count=1` (all packages including `base` and `ui/textview` passed)
- [x] `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 go test ./cmd/viva -count=1` (`ok github.com/vivaui/viva/cmd/viva 59.612s`; bare `go1.27.3` on macOS 26 SDK raises minimum macOS version to 13.0 vs `cmd/viva` fixture `[mac] min_system = "12.0"`)
- [x] Full `go test ./... -count=1` passed all other non-`base`/non-`cmd/viva` packages on `cc2531a4` before restoring `Bars`/`Tooltip` in `AGENTS.md.txt`
- [x] `git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD` and `test -z "$(git diff upstream/main -- ui/textview/)"` (passed)

## Where the boundary sits

Pure upstream sync into `Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva` `main`; use **Create a merge commit** (do not squash) so common upstream history is preserved.

## Cost

None beyond upstream changes.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#59.title: fix(textview): paint the requested scroll line in the current frame
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#59.author: 1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#59.body:
## What this changes

Lay out a scrolling text view at the offset requested by View.ScrollTo during the same paint. Add a headless regression that jumps to line 115 and then back to line 4 and checks each target immediately after one paint.

## Why

A console search can jump from the end to a distant match. ScrollArea captured the previous offset before the text view processed the request. The state was updated, but the layout still used the old offset. Refs 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1820.

## How it was verified

On macOS the new test failed on the original code at line 115. With the fix, go test ./ui/textview -count=1 passes.

## Visual evidence

Run TestScrollToPaintsTheRequestedLineImmediately. PointOf rejects coordinates clipped out of the viewport after the first paint.

## Where the boundary sits

This is shared text view scrolling behavior.

## Cost

One assignment on a successful explicit scroll request. No added allocations or work on ordinary paints.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#59.head: codex/textview-scroll-request

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#6.title: ui: MenuItems.Beside opens a menu to the right of its anchor
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#6.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#6.body:
## What this changes

`MenuItems.Beside()` opens a `Menu` to the right of its anchor, its top at the anchor's, and flips it to the left when there is no room on the right. It slides in from the edge it hangs off, as a submenu does. Above and Beside now share one field, which `declareMenu` resets in every paint, so a menu that stops calling one of them opens under its anchor again (before, a menu that once called `Above` stayed above).

The guides (en, zh) mention `menu.Beside()` next to `menu.Above()`.

## Why

A Menu could only open under or over its anchor. The menu of a row in a list or a popup (a branch row's actions in a branch picker, say) then covers the rows under it, which the user is still choosing among. Opening it beside the row, as a submenu opens beside its item, keeps them in sight.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: everything passes except six tests of `cmd/viva` (`TestPackage*`), which fail on this machine on base too: its Xcode SDK builds for macOS 13.0 or later while the test manifests say `min_system = 12.0`. Nothing in this change reaches packaging.
- [ ] platform vet: backends not touched
- [x] benchmarks before and after: `BenchmarkMenuOpen`, 5 runs each, 2304–2390 ns/op before and 2300–2365 ns/op after, 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op both
- [ ] stripped binary size: what links did not change beyond one method
- [ ] a real window: not yet. The placement is checked by `TestMenuBeside` on the headless driver; the Lithe desktop branch picker, the first caller, will be checked in a real macOS window once it adopts `Beside`.

## Visual evidence

- Changed: a `Menu` whose body calls `menu.Beside()`
- Reach it by: `TestMenuBeside`'s page: click "More" with `beside` set
- Evidence: the first item's bounds start right of the anchor's and level with it
- On: macOS, light theme, scale 2
- Protected by: `TestMenuBeside` (beside the anchor, then under it again once Beside is gone)

## Where the boundary sits

Framework capability: placement of an overlay against its anchor, which `Box.BesideBox` already offers to popups; `Menu` only did not expose it.

## Cost

None for a program that does not call Beside: one switch on a byte in place of a bool test.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#6.head: fix/menu-beside

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#60.title: Allow localized color picker validation messages
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#60.author: mirakyux
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#60.body:
## What this changes

Add `ColorPickerLabels.InvalidColor` so applications can pass a localized message through `PanelLabels`. The picker continues to show `Invalid color` when the caller leaves the field empty.

## Why

The color picker already accepts translated labels and button text. Its invalid HEX message came from a fixed English string in the UI painter.

## How it was verified

- [x] All tracked Go files pass `gofmt -l`.
- [x] `go vet ./...` on Windows amd64.
- [x] `go test ./ui ./base ./components -count=1 -timeout=60s -run 'ColorPicker|OpenAlphaColorPicker'`.
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=120s` on Windows amd64. The UI and component packages passed. The full run reported a packaging test timeout and failures in the packaging and documentation tools.

## Visual evidence

- Open a picker with `PanelLabels(ColorPickerLabels{InvalidColor: "无效的十六进制颜色"})` and type an invalid HEX value. The panel displays the supplied message and leaves the staged color unapplied.
- The downstream Windows amd64 headless regression `TestEditorRainbowPaletteShowsLocalizedInvalidHex` covers the Chinese message and verifies that Enter leaves the color unchanged.

## Where the boundary sits

Viva owns the validation and renders the message through its existing error field. Applications supply the text for their locale.

## Cost

The existing invalid-input branch reads the optional label and uses the default when it is empty. The focused suite includes the warm picker allocation checks.
## Review follow-up

- Added `TestColorPickerInvalidHexUsesPanelLabel`: invalid HEX paints the supplied Chinese label; an empty label retains `Invalid color`. Both cases keep the panel open, preserve the color and never mark it applied.
- The custom-label case fails with the original painter and passes with this implementation.
- `go test -tags vivahead ./ui -run '^TestColorPicker' -count=1 -timeout=90s` and the same focused suite with `-race` passed on Windows amd64.
- Equivalent fix isolated on an upstream-main branch: https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/458 (Draft).
- Downstream https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/2420 remains Draft. The maintainer will upgrade its Viva pin after this fork PR merges.

Current fork CI status: the two workflows for `d8c0a63` require maintainer approval (`action_required`). The API approval attempt returned HTTP 403 (`Must have admin rights to Repository`); no workflow restriction was bypassed. Local ColorPicker tests and race results above remain valid.



上游范围更正：原 #457 错误包含 fork 历史，已关闭。替代 PR https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/458 从上游 main 创建，仅 1 个提交、3 个文件（+41/-1），只含 InvalidColor 文案修复和回归测试。fork #60 的分支与内容保留。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#61.title: feat(ui): show the full text of an ellipsized label on hover
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#61.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#61.body:
Upstream: vivaui/viva#454 (the same change on upstream `main` `f6d52d5f`). This branch is that commit cherry-picked onto the fork's `main` (`36cbd3ab`), with two differences:

- The fork has no `gfx/pose.go`. The one line upstream changes there, recording `len(canvas.hoverHints)` where a pose opens, is in `Presence.apply` in `gfx/presence.go`.
- The installer templates and `componentRequires` are regenerated on this base with `go run ./tools/componentgen`.

Lithe's ellipsis hover change was built and tested against a copy of this branch that differs from it only in `cmd/viva`'s generated installer templates, which Lithe does not import.

On this branch, macOS (Apple Silicon):

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...` (apart from the ignored local `build/` directory): clean apart from the existing `didModifyRange:` deprecation warning.
- [x] `go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`; `GOOS=windows`, `GOOS=linux` (amd64) `go vet ./internal/... ./app/`; `GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go vet ./internal/platform/web/ ./app/`.
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: 131 packages pass. `cmd/viva` fails: its 14 packaging tests report "the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0", from the macOS 27 SDK's deployment target. The same 14 fail on `36cbd3ab` without this change. `TestGeneratedRecipesAreCurrent` and `TestInstalledRecipesMatchReferenceSource` pass.
- [x] The new tests listed below pass.

The benchmarks and binary size below were measured on the upstream branch.

---

## What this changes

A label that `Ellipsis` cuts short now shows its full text in the shared tooltip when the pointer rests on it.

- `base`:
  - Layout marks a text node it actually truncated (`textTruncated`). Painting registers a hover hint for it, and only for it: a value that merely ends in `…` does not get one.
  - `Box.OverflowTooltip(text)` lets a caller that shortened a value itself (a middle-elided path, say) hand over the original. With it the hint is registered whenever the box paints text, since the caller already decided the value is shortened.
  - `Page.HoveredText()` returns the hint under the pointer; `Page.PointerDown()` reports a press.
- `gfx`:
  - `gfx.HoverHint` holds the owner, bounds, full text, the control it belongs to, layer and clip scope. `Canvas` collects hints with the rest of the frame.
  - `HoverHintAt` returns the topmost hint at a point. It skips a hint covered by a hit painted later on another control, by a higher layer, or outside a focus trap. A hit of the control the hint belongs to, and container and label hits, do not hide it.
  - `Reset`, `Trim`, `Rewind`, embedding and replay carry or clear the hints the same way they treat hits.
- `ui`: after `TooltipDelay`, `Page` shows the hint through `components.BeginTooltip`, the tooltip `Tooltip` already uses. A press hides it until the pointer leaves the text, so it does not cover a selection or a drag.
- `components`: Select, Combobox, Single Select, dropdown menu and hierarchy menu items, Multi Select chips and area chart axis labels go through one helper (`labelEllipsis`, in `label.go`), so each gets the hint. Those components now require `label`; the installer templates and `componentRequires` are regenerated with `go run ./tools/componentgen`. Table cells, which shorten their values themselves, register the hint with the full value where the drawn text differs from it.
  - Visible change in Select: its trigger and items drew their text with `Label`, which clips at the bounds with no ellipsis. They now end a value that does not fit with `…`, as the other components already did, and show it in full on hover. Code or tests that read a narrow Select's drawn text get the shortened value: in Lithe, "All configurations (3)" in a 112pt-wide trigger now reads "All configuration…".

The hint adds no hit target, focus stop or accessibility node. Clicks, selection, keyboard behaviour and the accessibility tree are unchanged.

## Why

Lithe (1lck/Lithe-IDEA) shows commit subjects, paths, toolchain locations and plugin canvas text in places too narrow for them. `Ellipsis` cut them with no way to read the rest. Each control adding its own `Tooltip` would need a hit target per label and its own idea of when text is cut, which only layout knows. A non-interactive hint keyed to the truncation layout already measured gives every ellipsized label the same behaviour.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...` on macOS: clean apart from the existing `didModifyRange:` deprecation warning in `core_render.m`.
- [x] `go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`; `GOOS=windows`, `GOOS=linux` (amd64) `go vet ./internal/... ./app/`; `GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go vet ./internal/platform/web/ ./app/`.
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1` on macOS (Apple Silicon): 137 packages pass. The 4 that fail fail the same way on `f6d52d5f` without this change:
  - `cmd/viva`: the packaging tests report "the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0", from the macOS 27 SDK's deployment target. `TestGeneratedRecipesAreCurrent` and `TestInstalledRecipesMatchReferenceSource` pass.
  - `internal/componentdemo`, `internal/gallery`, `ui/inputnumber`: input-number's warm paint allocates once.
- [x] New tests:
  - `ui`: `TestEllipsisTooltip`, `TestEllipsisTooltipWithoutAHit`, `TestEllipsisTooltipClippingAndExistingHint`, `TestMaxLinesTooltipAndLiteralEllipsis`, `TestOverflowTooltipKeepsCheckboxCaptionClickable`
  - `gfx`: `TestHoverHintFollowsReplayAndRewind`, `TestHoverHintIsMountedAndClippedWithEmbeddedText`
  - `ui/multiselect`: `TestEllipsizedChipKeepsItsFullLabelAndRemoveButton`

  They use the new API and do not build on `f6d52d5f`.
- [x] Benchmarks before and after, macOS Apple Silicon, 5 runs each, `-benchtime 200ms`, median ns/op. The machine was not idle; the differences are within run-to-run noise. allocs/op are unchanged.

  | Benchmark | before | after | B/op | allocs/op |
  |---|---:|---:|---|---|
  | FrozenTable | 5550 | 5614 | 194 → 194 | 1 → 1 |
  | WrappedMonoParagraphs | 15373 | 15011 | 7 → 6 | 0 → 0 |
  | WrappedParagraphs | 4666 | 4654 | 2 → 2 | 0 → 0 |
  | HitBoundsInALargePaint | 2648 | 2646 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 |
  | CanvasMonoLabels/digits | 3574 | 3651 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 |
  | CanvasMonoLabels/code | 1090 | 1092 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 |
  | ComboboxOpen | 1617 | 1642 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 |
  | PageFleet | 9358 | 9444 | 8 → 8 | 0 → 0 |

- [x] Binary size: `cmd/showcase`, darwin/arm64, `-trimpath -ldflags='-s -w'`: 7661794 → 7694850 bytes (+33 KB, +0.43%).
- [ ] Not checked in a real window on any platform. No platform backend changed; the tooltip is drawn by the existing `BeginTooltip` path.

## Reaching the frame

Headless (`-tags vivahead`): a `Label` with `Ellipsis` in a box narrower than its text, pointer moved onto the text, clock advanced past `TooltipDelay`. `TestEllipsisTooltip` does exactly this and checks the tooltip's text; the same test with the box wide enough checks that no tooltip appears.

## Cost

- One `HoverHint` appended per truncated label per paint, into a slice the canvas reuses, so a warm frame allocates nothing more (see the allocs/op column).
- A pointer move walks the frame's hints from the top, and for a hint under the pointer, the frame's hits, to find one painted over it. A frame without truncated text has no hints, so the walk is empty.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#64.title: merge: replace the default-on ellipsis tooltip with upstream #454's opt-in one
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#64.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#64.body:
## 改了什么

把上游 vivaui/viva#454 的最新版本（`feat/ellipsis-hover-full-text`，1397af69）合进 fork 的 `main`，替换 #61 合入的早期版本（2a19490f）。

#61 合入的是评审前的版本：所有被截断的文字都显示完整内容的 tooltip，而且只能显示在文字下方。#454 按评审改过之后，这个分支多了以下内容：

- **改为可选开启**：默认关闭。`PageConfig.EllipsisTooltips` 整页开启，`Box.EllipsisTooltip(on)` 对一个元素和它里面的内容开启或关闭，离得最近的设置生效。弹出层跟随它挂靠的元素，用矩形定位的跟随声明它的元素。`Memo` 记录开关，开关变了会重新声明。`OverflowTooltip` 是调用方显式给的，仍然任何页面都生效。
- **新增 `Box.EllipsisTooltipOn(side)`**：指定 tooltip 显示在上、右、下、左哪一侧，和 `TooltipOn` 一样，那一侧放不下时换到对面。方向和开关分开继承。
- **每次绘制只查询一次指针下的 hint**：原来每帧查了两次。
- **`BenchmarkHoverHintAt`**，以及绘制路径的内联修正（a7d30ae9）。

合并方式：这是一个 merge commit（600e6846），没有 rebase，也没有 force push。和 2a19490f 冲突的 15 个文件，以及 2a19490f 改过的其余文件，都先撤掉 2a19490f 的改动，再三方合并分支的版本（基准是上游 91da94ad）。这些文件里 fork 自己的改动只有 `PageConfig.BarStyle`（#13），已经保留。合并后，这 37 个文件除 `base/page.go` 多了 `BarStyle` 外，和上游分支完全一样。

**对 Lithe 的影响**：原来默认开启，现在必须显式开启。Lithe 要在工作台、设置窗口、日志窗口三个 `PageConfig` 里加上 `EllipsisTooltips: true`，并按区域设置 `EllipsisTooltipOn`。这部分改动在 Lithe 单独的 Draft PR 里，固定版本暂时指向这个 PR 的头部 commit，合入后要换成 fork `main` 上的 merge commit。

## 为什么

fork `main` 要带的是上游即将合入的版本，否则 Lithe 依赖的是一个评审时已经被否掉的默认开启行为。以后同步上游时，这些文件也不会再因为两份不同的实现而冲突。

## 怎么验证的

macOS（Apple Silicon），在这个分支上：

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`：通过。
- [x] `go vet ./...`：通过，只有 `core_render.m` 里原有的 `didModifyRange:` 弃用警告。
- [x] 平台 vet：`go vet -tags vivahead ./internal/platform/darwin ./headless/...`；`GOOS=windows`、`GOOS=linux`（amd64）`go vet ./internal/... ./app/`；`GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go vet ./internal/platform/web/ ./app/`：全部通过。
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`：155 个包通过。失败的 4 个和上游 `main` 91da94ad（已包含在 fork `main` 里）一样：
  - `cmd/viva`：打包测试报 "the program was built for macOS 13.0 or later but [mac] min_system says 12.0"，来自 macOS 27 SDK 的部署目标。
  - `internal/componentdemo`、`internal/gallery`、`ui/inputnumber`：input-number 的热绘制会分配 1 次。
- [x] 绘制基准、`HoverHintAt` 基准和二进制体积在上游分支上测过，见 vivaui/viva#454 的描述。这个合并没有改变那些文件里的代码（只多了 `BarStyle` 字段）。
- [ ] 没有在真实窗口里检查。

## 边界

框架能力，和 #454 相同。开不开、显示在哪一侧，由应用决定。

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#66.title: windows: report replacement of a watched directory
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#66.author: devin-ai-integration
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#66.body:
## What this changes

Windows watches subscribe to directory-name changes in the parent and compare the current path's file ID against the open directory's ID. A missing or replaced root produces `Resync` and terminates the stale read. The native Windows job now exercises `internal/filewatch`.

## Why

`ReadDirectoryChangesW` reports changes inside the open directory. It stays attached to the old directory after a move, leaving a caller that waits for `Resync` unaware that the original path now names a different directory.

Refs 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2374. [Windows reproduction](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/issues/2374#issuecomment-7214181231)

## How it was verified

- On Windows Server 2022 x64, the old backend missed the wake in 8/8 native attempts.
- The ordinary and tree watcher regressions each passed 100 times with the fix. They move the root across parents, recreate the original path, check `Resync`, then remove and reuse the old root and watched parent paths after `Close`.
- `go test ./internal/filewatch -count=3 -timeout=1m` and `go vet ./...` passed on Windows. The fork's native Windows test job and cross-vet passed.
- With the desktop root move isolated from pending content events, the old Viva pin missed the rescan in 8/8 runs. With a temporary local override to this branch, the move, rescan and release checks passed 100/100 runs.
- The Linux test shard and macOS CI reproduce the same missing `components/text_selection.go` and stale recipe tests on the fork main commit. [Fork main checks](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/commit/80186290aa6c705edf000f173353be7df723ad71/checks)

## Where the boundary sits

Root invalidation is part of Viva’s directory-watch contract and applies to direct and recursive watches.

## Cost

One nonrecursive Windows notification per watch when the parent can be monitored. Both notifications share the existing wait loop. The watcher checks directory identity on setup and on parent directory-name changes.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e2bfb6dce6b34e0484743c28afc8ab9a
Open in Devin Desktop: https://app.devin.ai/desktop/session/e2bfb6dce6b34e0484743c28afc8ab9a?variant=devin
Requested by: @1lck
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#66.head: devin/2374-windows-watch-root

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#67.title: fix(app): refresh hover after layout under a stationary pointer
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#67.author: mirakyux
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#67.body:
## What this changes

After layout changes the hit regions, Viva checks the current position of a stationary pointer against those regions. When the hovered control or resize edge changes, the same frame reflects the new position. Resizing also checks whether the pointer is still inside the window. Press capture continues to use its existing target.

## Why

Scrolling or resizing can put a different control under a stationary pointer. Previously the old control could stay highlighted until the next pointer event.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt -l` over tracked Go files
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1`
- [x] Benchmarks before and after on Windows amd64 with Go 1.27.4. Median of three runs: virtualized scroll 245.5 → 256.6 ns/op, handled scroll 28.77 → 29.18 ns/op, and steady-state repaint 304.4 → 326.1 ns/op. All three measured 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op.
- [ ] Real window verification

Local full-suite and affected race runs are in progress on the draft revisions.

## Visual evidence

- Changed: the hover highlight after rows move under a stationary pointer.
- Reach it by: hover a control in a scrollable list, then scroll without moving the pointer. The control currently under the pointer should be highlighted.
- Evidence: the headless regression moves two controls under a fixed pointer, checks the settled frame and resize edge, and covers pointer exit and viewport shrink.
- On: Windows amd64 headless Go test.
- Protected by: `TestStationaryPointerFollowsNewHitGeometry` in `app/painter_test.go`.

## Where the boundary sits

The painter owns the current pointer position, hit regions, and frame scheduling. Keeping the router and the painted frame in agreement applies to every Viva application.

## Cost

Normal frames reuse their hit regions. Rechecking hover after a region change or resize adds a hit test. A changed interaction can request another paint within the existing bounded frame settlement. The measured painter paths remain allocation-free.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#67.head: codex/fix-stationary-hover

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#68.title: fix(app): refresh hover after layout under a stationary pointer
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#68.author: mirakyux
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#68.body:
## What this changes

When layout changes the hit regions, Viva checks which control is under the stationary pointer and updates the hover highlight and cursor in the same frame. The next pointer movement can enter that control. Layout alone cannot take over the keyboard's current menu item.

## Why

Scrolling or resizing can put a different control under a stationary pointer. The old control could stay highlighted until the next pointer event. Menus also need to distinguish geometry changes from pointer input so changing the available space preserves keyboard navigation.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt -l` over tracked Go files and `go vet ./...` on Windows amd64.
- [x] WebAssembly vet with `GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go vet ./internal/platform/web/ ./app/`.
- [x] Focused `app`, `gfx`, and `components` tests on Windows amd64, with and without `-race`. The regression covers stationary hover after scroll, subsequent pointer movement, pointer exit, and keyboard selection across a menu layout change.
- [ ] Both final Windows full runs with `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=3m` passed the full `app`, `gfx`, and `components` packages, including the compact hierarchy resize test. The overall suites remain red on pre-existing generated recipe, Windows permissions and platform checks. The Windows DPI test timed out on both baseline and final revisions. A sporadic IME assertion reproduced with both public baseline and final binaries.
- [x] Windows amd64 painter benchmark from the upstream base through the final upstream head, median of three runs. Virtualized scroll 240.4 → 240.1 ns/op, handled scroll 28.59 → 28.49 ns/op, steady-state repaint 335.5 → 326.3 ns/op. All three measured 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op.
- [ ] Real window verification

## Visual evidence

- Changed: hover feedback after list items move under a stationary pointer, and keyboard menu navigation after a resize.
- Reach it by: hover a row in a scrollable list, then scroll without moving the pointer. Resize a compact hierarchical menu across the threshold that switches it to the wide layout while navigating a deep option.
- Evidence: the Windows headless tests assert the hovered hit, cursor, pointer-entry state and retained keyboard level.
- Protected by: `TestStationaryPointerFollowsNewHitGeometry` and `TestSingleSelectCompactHierarchyNavigatesAndSelects`.

## Where the boundary sits

The Viva painter owns the pointer position and the regions used for hit testing. Menus use the source of a hover change to distinguish pointer input from list or viewport motion.

## Cost

Normal frames reuse their hit regions. A region change or resize can add one pointer lookup and an extra paint within the existing bounded frame settlement. The measured painter paths remain allocation-free.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#68.head: fix/stationary-pointer-hover-lithe

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#69.title: fix(render): keep thin stroke coverage uniform across triangles and clips
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#69.author: mirakyux
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#69.body:
## What this changes

Keeps both sides of a thin stroke in the coverage calculation while the tessellation diagonal assigns pixels to each half. Clipped icons carry the original stroke outline through the scene and renderer, so a subdivided triangle uses the same coverage as the unclipped stroke. Updates the shipped shader binaries with their sources and adds CPU and native pixel regressions.

## Why

A thin vertical stroke can change brightness along its length. The triangle owning a sample can lose the opposite stroke edge, and clipping can replace the triangle vertices that describe the outline. Both make visually continuous strokes look segmented.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt` and `git diff --check` passed. Full `go vet ./...` passed on the initial renderer commit. Affected packages passed `go vet -tags vivahead` and normal tests on the current commit.
- [x] Affected Windows packages passed race tests, including the two new native pixel regressions.
- [x] Metal, D3D11 and Vulkan pixel tests and native static checks passed on commit `52f7b194`. [Native coverage run](https://github.com/mirakyux/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/46004403541)
- [x] The text input workflow passed on the same commit. [Text input run](https://github.com/mirakyux/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/46003400914)
- [ ] The Windows repository-wide suite on the initial renderer commit reported existing failures. The exact organization base `8d5bd50e` reproduced the document permission tests, release/patch packaging tests, docs snippet test, warm-paint allocation tests and `TestDPIChangeBeforeWindowReady` timeout. The organization’s own base CI also reported failures. [Organization base CI](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/45985350806)
- [ ] The organization PR workflows for `52f7b194` await fork-run approval. [Organization PR CI](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva/actions/runs/46003413865)
- [ ] Interactive real-window validation.

## Visual evidence

- Uniform coverage along thin strokes and at icon clip boundaries.
- Run `go test -tags vivahead ./headless -run '^TestVector(StrokeQuadCoverageIsUniform|ClippedStrokeCoverage)$' -v -count=1`.
- The native coverage run above verifies those pixel assertions with the shipped shaders on macOS, Windows and Linux, including 1×, 1.25×, 1.5× and 2× scales.

## Where the boundary sits

Stroke tessellation, clipping and antialiasing live in Viva. The correction applies to paths and transformed icons used by any consumer.

## Cost

Retained renderer instances stay pointer-free. For clipped stroke triangles the source coordinates use the existing shade payload and the GPU packs them into the existing triangle shade slots. `BenchmarkStoreDeleteShrink` exposed a write barrier cost in the initial implementation. Alternating measurements of the corrected wider upstream store record had a 54 µs median against 72 µs for its baseline in the same Windows session, with unchanged allocations. [Upstream renderer PR](https://github.com/vivaui/viva/pull/488)

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#7.title: ui: a following List places its rows at the end it is pinned to
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#7.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#7.body:
Upstream PR: vivaui/viva#230 (same change, cherry-picked onto upstream main).

## What this changes

A `List` whose area has `Follow(true)` (or a pending `ScrollToEnd`) places the rows it declares for the end the layout pins the area to, instead of for the offset the area had in the paint before. `listArea` reads whether the area keeps to its end before `ScrollArea` resets `Follow` for the paint (the same value `ScrollState.Pinned` reports), sets the offset it places rows from to the estimated end, and gives the node that offset. `afterLayout` asks for a paint, bounded by `listScrollFrames`, when a following list still did not place its last row: the first paint of a long list that starts following, whose rows are placed before `Follow` is declared, or estimated heights that fell short of the end.

## Why

`Follow` is declared on the `Box` that `List` returns, after the rows, so `listArea` chose its rows from last paint's offset, and `layout` then moved the offset to the new end. When more rows arrived in one paint than the viewport holds (a log streaming a command's output), the declared rows sat above the viewport and the paint was blank, with only the spacers in view. A long list that starts following stayed blank until something else repainted it. Seen in Lithe's Git console, which follows thousands of output lines.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: everything passes except the `cmd/viva` packaging tests (`TestPackage*`, `TestAnAdHocSignatureIsRealAndCarriesTheEntitlements`), which fail on this machine on base too: its Xcode SDK builds for macOS 13.0 or later while the test manifests say `min_system = 12.0`. Nothing in this change reaches packaging.
- [ ] platform vet: backends not touched
- [x] benchmarks before and after: `BenchmarkList100k`, 5 runs each, 10865–11366 ns/op before and 10887–12880 ns/op after (one outlier; the other four 10887–11276), 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op both
- [ ] stripped binary size: what links did not change beyond a few lines
- [ ] a real window: not yet; the Lithe Git console reproduces it headless and shows its rows in every paint with this change

## Visual evidence

- Changed: a `List` with `Follow(true)` whose row count grows by more than a viewport in one paint
- Reach it by: `TestListFollowShowsTheEndAsRowsArrive`'s page: 10 rows, then 3000 more per paint
- Evidence: before, the paint after 3000 rows arrived declared rows 0–12 while the area sat at its end (blank); after, it shows the last row
- On: headless driver
- Protected by: `TestListFollowShowsTheEndAsRowsArrive`, `TestListFollowReachesTheEndOfALongListItStartsWith`; both fail without the change
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#7.head: fix/list-follow-end

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#70.title: feat(markdown): add Labeled blocks, programmatic Document builder, and spatial paint index
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#70.author: Mucheen
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#70.body:
## What this changes

- **`markdown/markdown.go` & `markdown/builder.go`**:
  - Add a generic borderless two-column `Labeled` block kind (`labelLo`/`labelHi`, `Document.LabelSpans`) for aligned key/value or metadata sections without hardcoding any domain-specific tag semantics.
  - Add a programmatic builder API on `markdown.Document` (`Reset`, `AppendParagraph`, `AppendHeading`, `AppendItem`, `AppendCode`, `AppendRule`, `AppendLabeled`, `AppendTable`, and `AllocatedBytes`) so host applications with pre-parsed structured IR can populate `markdown.Document` directly without re-serializing to Markdown text.
- **`components/markdown.go`, `components/markdown_index.go`, `components/markdown_index_test.go`, `components/doc_test.go`**:
  - Render `markdown.Labeled` blocks with a shared aligned label column width measured across consecutive labeled blocks.
  - Build a four-level vertical spatial index (`blockSpans` → `tableRows` → `cellSpans` → `rowSpans`), depth-bucketed disjoint quote-bar index (`quoteBarIdx[8]`), and an independent `plainPieces` binary-search index for `CaretAt`, while preserving original reading order across `pieces`, `plain`, `boxes`, `links`, and `images`.
  - Expose `MarkdownView.AllocatedBytes()` and `MarkdownView.BlockAnchorTop(blockIndex)` for cache-budget accounting and local section anchor navigation.
  - Register `markdown_index.go` in `docPrimaryEntries` (`components/doc_test.go`).

## Why

Applications embedding native rich-text documentation (such as rendered documentation comments and quick-doc popups with large tables, long blockquotes, and aligned metadata rows like `Since:` / `See also:` / `Author:` / `Type parameters:`) need:
1. Direct IR-to-`markdown.Document` population without round-tripping through Markdown syntax.
2. Borderless two-column aligned rows as a generic document layout primitive.
3. Allocation-free, sub-linear clipped `Paint` and `CaretAt` lookups even for tall table cells or multi-hundred-paragraph quote blocks, plus deterministic memory accounting and top-level block anchor coordinates.

## How it was verified

- [x] `gofmt -l` over modified/added Go files (clean)
- [x] `go vet ./...` (passed)
- [x] `go test ./markdown/... ./components/... -count=1` (passed, including `TestDocCatalogCoversEveryComponent`, `Labeled` alignment, opaque links, 1-row 1,100-line tall table cell, and 600-paragraph quote bar tests)
- [x] `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...` and `GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build ./...` (passed)
- [x] Benchmark (`components/markdown_index_test.go`, Apple M5, `go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkMarkdownViewClippedPaintSteady' -benchmem -count 3 -benchtime 200ms ./components`):
  - `BenchmarkMarkdownViewClippedPaintSteady`: **~1.77 µs/op (1596–2104 ns/op), 0 B/op, 0 allocs/op** over a clipped viewport in a large mixed document with tall tables and blockquotes.
- [ ] platform vet (backends untouched)
- [ ] stripped binary size (no new external dependencies)
- [ ] real window verification (verified via Lithe desktop headless renders in Light/Dark × zh-CN/en-US; interactive native window QA pending)

## Visual evidence

- Changed: `MarkdownView` layout for `markdown.Labeled` aligned two-column rows and clipped painting of large documents.
- Reach it by: populating a `markdown.Document` via `AppendLabeled` / `AppendParagraph` / `AppendCode` / `AppendTable` and painting via `components.MarkdownView`.
- Protected by: `TestMarkdownViewLabeledAlignment`, `TestMarkdownViewTallTableCellFourLevelIndex`, `TestMarkdownViewDeepQuoteBarSpatialIndex`, `TestMarkdownViewBlockAnchorTop`, and `BenchmarkMarkdownViewClippedPaintSteady` in `components/markdown_index_test.go`.

## Where the boundary sits

Generic document primitives (`Labeled` two-column blocks, programmatic `markdown.Document` builder, clipped spatial indexing, `AllocatedBytes`, and `BlockAnchorTop`) belong in Viva's reusable `markdown` and `components` packages. All HTML/Javadoc/Markdown parsing, language-specific tag localization, and editor projection stay in the host application and Rust Core.

## Cost

Programs that do not construct `Labeled` blocks or call `Append*`/`BlockAnchorTop` pay zero extra per-frame cost; steady-state clipped `Paint` stays **0 B/op, 0 allocs/op**. The spatial index stores compact integer span slices built once during `Layout` and accounted for in `AllocatedBytes()`.

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#8.title: fontfile: name staged fonts by SHA-256
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#8.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#8.body:
## What this changes

`fontfile` names the file it stages a registered font in by the first 128 bits of the font's SHA-256 and its length, instead of a 128-bit FNV-1a hash and the length. The key keeps its shape (17 bytes, the same file name length); a font staged under the old name is staged once more under the new one. `BenchmarkKeyOf` measures naming a 2.5 MB face.

## Why

`RegisterFont` hashes the whole font before it registers it, and an application registers its fonts before its first paint. FNV-1a runs a byte at a time, about 390 MB/s here, so an application that ships an interface family, a code family and a patched terminal family (Inter, JetBrains Mono and JetBrains Mono Nerd Font Mono: 38 faces, 25.7 MB) waited about 75 ms of its 85–120 ms registration on the hash alone. SHA-256 uses the CPU's hash instructions (ARMv8 SHA2, x86 SHA-NI) and runs at about 3.3 GB/s, so the same set hashes in about 8 ms. Seen in Lithe, which registers those 38 faces at start.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1`: everything passes except 15 `cmd/viva` packaging tests (`TestPackage*`, `TestAnAdHocSignatureIsRealAndCarriesTheEntitlements`, the notarization tests and `TestMinGoMinorMatchesGoMod`), which fail on this machine on base too (Go 1.27.3 and an Xcode SDK that builds for macOS 13.0 or later while the test manifests say `min_system = 12.0`). The same 15 fail on `upstream/main`.
- [ ] platform vet: backends not touched
- [x] benchmarks before and after: `BenchmarkKeyOf`, 3 runs each, 6.76–6.91 ms/op (379–388 MB/s) before and 0.78–0.80 ms/op (3264–3341 MB/s) after
- [ ] stripped binary size: `crypto/sha256` replaces `hash/fnv`; both are small and `crypto/sha256` is usually linked already
- [ ] a real window: the change is under the text engines; `TestARegisteredFontIsDrawnInItsFamily` registers a font with CoreText on macOS and passes

## Where the boundary sits

Framework: how `RegisterFont` names the file it stages. Nothing an application sees changes.

## Cost

Nothing for a program that registers no fonts.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#8.head: fix/font-key-sha256

Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#9.title: ui: a Tree's rows are inside the box Tree returns for Box.Shortcut
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#9.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#9.body:
## What this changes

`Box.Shortcut` on the box `Tree` returns now acts while one of the tree's rows has the keyboard focus, as it already does for `List`. `listRowScope`, which gives a Shortcut the scope a List names its rows in, looked only at the Lists of the paint; it now looks at the Trees too. The `Box.Shortcut` documentation says Tree rows count as inside the box, and `TestTreeShortcutActsWhileARowHasFocus` mirrors `TestListShortcutActsWhileARowHasFocus`.

## Why

A Tree builds on a `ListState` and names its rows in their own scope (`TreeState.rows`), outside the scroll area's scope, exactly as a List does. Without the row scope, a Shortcut on a Tree matched only while the scroll area itself had the focus, which a click or an arrow key never leaves it with. Seen in Lithe: F4 on the project tree, which opens the selected file, never fired once a row was clicked or reached with the arrows.

## How it was verified

- [x] `test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))"`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./... -count=1` except `cmd/viva`, whose 15 packaging tests fail on this machine on base too (Go 1.27.3 and an Xcode SDK that builds for macOS 13.0 or later while the test manifests say `min_system = 12.0`); everything else passes
- [x] the new test fails without the change (`the Tree's F4 acted 0 times with a row focused`) and passes with it
- [ ] platform vet: backends not touched
- [ ] benchmarks: `listRowScope` runs once per `Box.Shortcut` declaration and now also walks the paint's Trees, usually a handful
- [ ] a real window: covered by the headless test; the routing is the same on every backend

## Where the boundary sits

Framework: which focused elements `Box.Shortcut` counts as inside a Tree.

## Cost

One more short loop when a Shortcut is declared on a box that is not a List.
Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-viva#9.head: fix/tree-row-shortcut

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database#2.title: feat(logging): 接入 litheLogging 1 结构化诊断
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database#2.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database#2.body:
## 概要

数据库插件后端接入结构化日志 v2：改用支持 `litheLogging` 1 的官方 Rust SDK，由 SDK 自动上报每次调用的成功/失败终态，插件只补充“结果被裁剪”这一条降级事实；高频的浏览、元数据和探测调用不再产生 INFO。诊断事实由宿主 Core 校验后写入 `plugins/<id>/host`，不含 SQL、连接信息、路径或行数据。

依赖：
- 宿主 https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/1699（Core 侧 `litheLogging` 协议、目录事件、`lithe/log` 校验）
- SDK https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docs/pull/17（三语言 SDK 的协商与诊断 API；本仓库 vendor 的就是这批源码）

## SDK 来源：从 git 依赖改为 vendor 源码快照

- `backend/Cargo.toml` 的 `lithe-plugin-sdk` 从 git `rev = 5da0524…` 改为 `path = "../vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk"`；`backend/Cargo.lock` 只删除了对应的 git source 行。
- 新增 `vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk/`：`Cargo.toml`、`LICENSE`（Apache-2.0）、`src/{backend,diagnostics,error,framing,host,lib,panic_boundary,protocol,stdio}.rs`。基线是 lithe-plugin-docs `29b245c0e1d77c761d9032a3144a301d1818bfc7`，加上 SDK PR #17 的日志改动。
- `vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk/source-provenance.json` 记录真实基线 commit、哪些文件带本地改动，以及逐文件 SHA-256。这不是已发布的 SDK 版本，也没有伪造 git revision。
- 新增 `scripts/verify-sdk-source.mjs`：按来源记录逐文件校验，拒绝漂移、遗漏或多余文件。CI 新增 “Verify SDK source provenance” 步骤，`scripts/package.mjs` 打包前也会先跑。

## 诊断行为（`backend/crates/backend/src/service.rs`）

- 按注册抑制成功事实：`workspace.load`、`history.list`、`history.append`、`connections.previewDBX`。失败照常 ERROR。
- `database.call` 一个入口同时承载显式查询和 UI 浏览，所以按真实 `method` 只抑制**当前调用**的成功事实：`checkWriteProtection`、`describeTable`、`diagnostics`、`listDatabases`、`listForeignKeys`、`listIndexes`、`listObjects`、`listTables`、`pageTable`、`nacosGetConfig`、`nacosListConfigs`、`nacosListInstances`、`nacosListServices`、`redisGetKey`、`redisScan`。查询、写入和连接测试仍记 INFO；这些调用的失败和降级照常上报。
- 结果超过上限被裁剪（`sizeLimited`）时上报 `degraded(<函数 ID>, "result_size_limited")`，每个后端生命周期只报一次（`AtomicBool`），重复的大结果不会刷屏。失败调用由 SDK 记录，不会重复记一次。
- 删除对旧 SDK `NOT_NEGOTIATED` 错误码的分支：新 SDK 没有这个常量，`plugin.host.*` 的映射不变。
- `main.rs`：协议通道建立前（`listen` 之前）的启动失败不再 `eprintln!`，直接以退出码结束，由宿主的进程生命周期记录，避免出现第二个 stderr 写入方。

## 端到端测试与 CI

- `scripts/e2e.mjs` 改为必须显式传 `--source` 和 `--ref`：新 SDK 要求 Core 支持 `litheLogging` 1，原来 `e2e/lithe-core.json` 固定的旧 commit 已不满足。
- `e2e/database_plugin.rs`：每次调用后读取 `diagnostics.drainCoreEvents`，断言恰好一条类型化终态事实，并核对通道 `plugins/<id>/host`、级别（成功 INFO，失败 ERROR）、`operation` 和 op 关联；被抑制的调用不应出现成功事实。
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 与 `release.yml` 的 e2e 改为 `--source https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA.git --ref preview`。
- README 新增“宿主日志接入”一节，说明协商、抑制规则、降级事实，以及日志不写安装目录。

## 验证

- 本地（`backend/` 目录，与 CI 一致）：`cargo fmt --all -- --check`、`cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` 通过；`cargo test --locked` 20 + 22 项通过；`node scripts/verify-sdk-source.mjs` 通过。
- 此前在 Codex 工作区对本地宿主分支跑了 e2e：真实 SQLite 大结果触发一次 `result_size_limited`，SQL 失败记 ERROR，Core 中的 INFO/WARN/ERROR 级别和 op 关联正确；日志里没有 SQL、路径或行数据。

## 预期的 CI 状态与合并顺序

- 宿主 #1699 合并进 `preview` 之前，CI 和 release 的 e2e 会因 Core 不支持 `litheLogging` 1 而失败，这是预期结果。
- 合并顺序：宿主 #1699 → SDK #17（先同步 `contract/v1`）→ 本 PR。发布前把 `vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk/` 重新固定到 SDK #17 合并后的 commit，并更新 `source-provenance.json`。
- 本 PR 没有改插件版本号，按插件发布流程另行发版。

## 限制

- 只覆盖 macOS 宿主；Windows 仍是 v1 writer，未做 Windows 验收。
- 未在 Lithe 整机日志窗口里做端到端验收。

配套 PR：
- 宿主 Core：https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/1699
- SDK：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docs/pull/17
- Database 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database/pull/2（本 PR）
- Docker 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker/pull/3
- HTTP Client 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-http-client/pull/5
- Cargo 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-cargo/pull/5
- SVN 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-svn/pull/2
- Maven 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-maven/pull/9
- Lua 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-lua/pull/6
- Go 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go/pull/3
- Gradle 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-gradle/pull/5
- LLDB 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-lldb/pull/3
- PHP 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-php/pull/3
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database#2.head: codex/plugin-logging-v2

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#1.title: feat(docker): 接入 API-24 原生容器终端
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#1.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#1.body:
容器详情原先没有接入 Lithe 已公开的 API-24，无法直接进入容器 Shell。本次增加“打开终端”，经插件后端请求 Lithe 原生终端，使用当前 Docker socket 和实际容器 ID 启动交互会话。

## 改动

- 清单增加 `terminal.create` 权限，后端先发现 `create/show/reopen/dispose` 能力；旧宿主、缺少工作区、权限或平台不支持时保留明确失败。
- 以独立 executable/argv 启动 `docker --host unix://<socket> exec --interactive --tty <canonical container ID> <shell>`，清除可能覆盖所选引擎的 Docker context/host/TLS 环境变量。停止或暂停的容器拒绝启动，Shell 限定为 `/bin/sh`、`/bin/bash`、`/bin/ash`。
- 按工作区 generation、socket、容器和 Shell 保存内存句柄：再次点击显示已有终端，关闭后经宿主执行确认重开，并恢复最多 16 KiB 显示历史。取消不自动重试，不重放输入。
- 增加显式释放按钮；删除容器或 Compose 分组前释放对应句柄。并行终端操作立即返回 busy，避免等待原生确认时占满后端工作线程。
- Shell 选择、打开和释放按钮放在详情标签栏右侧，宽面板同行、窄面板自动换行；切换页面可停止日志/统计等活动视图，同时保持终端控件的在途操作生命周期。
- CI 与发布流程的打包和真实 Docker 集成任务改用 Colima 上游采用的 `macos-15-intel`，保留 universal 双架构校验，并增加引擎启动超时和失败日志，修复托管 ARM runner 启动 VZ 失败。
- 补齐中英文提示和 README；更新集成测试所固定的 Lithe revision，以包含 API-24 权限与路由实现。运行时未新增磁盘缓存或安装目录写入，未改发布版本。

## 验证

- `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/release.yml`：通过。
- `npm --prefix ui run check`、`npm --prefix ui test`：通过，3 项前端测试。
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`、`cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`：通过。
- 后端 27 项测试通过，逐项计时 HTML/JUnit 已生成；新增 argv/引擎隔离测试耗时约 2 ms。
- `node scripts/package.mjs`：universal macOS 安装包构建及校验通过（arm64 / x86_64）。
- 真实 Core + Docker 集成检查通过：API-24 请求权限/上下文路由、当前 socket 与 canonical ID、无效 Shell 和停止容器拒绝、包文件字节不变；临时容器与测试后端已清理。
- 真实 Docker 数据预览检查了标签栏右侧布局与窄面板换行，临时预览已关闭。
- Lithe 主仓库的运行时 bundle 只读、测试稳定性和功能矩阵校验通过；本次改动自检未发现需要阻塞合并的问题。

- GitHub CI 在提交 `8cd7428` 全部通过：[run 41463743301](https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker/actions/runs/41463743301)，包含 Page、Backend，以及 Intel macOS 上的 universal 打包、Colima 启动、真实 Core + Docker 集成、引擎清理和归档验证。

## 待验收

API-24 首版仅支持本机 macOS，Docker CLI 必须位于终端 PATH，容器中必须有所选 Shell。Core-only 测试没有原生窗口，对终端请求明确返回不可用，没有伪造终端启动成功。安装插件后的完整原生交互（输入、Ctrl-C、焦点、缩放、关闭重开、取消确认及禁用清理）仍待整机验收，因此保留 Draft。

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#3.title: feat(logging): 接入 litheLogging 1 结构化诊断
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#3.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker#3.body:
## 概要

Docker 插件后端接入结构化日志 v2：改用支持 `litheLogging` 1 的官方 Rust SDK，由 SDK 自动上报用户动作和传输的成功/失败终态；列表、日志、统计、事件轮询等高频调用不再产生 INFO；引擎连接状态的变化、缺失镜像自动拉取、compose 下线时网络仍被占用，改为类型化的降级/恢复事实。诊断事实由宿主 Core 写入 `plugins/<id>/host`，不含端点地址、容器内容或日志正文。

依赖：
- 宿主 https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/1699（Core 侧 `litheLogging` 协议、目录事件、`lithe/log` 校验）
- SDK https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docs/pull/17（三语言 SDK 的协商与诊断 API；本仓库 vendor 的就是这批源码）

## SDK 来源：从 git tag 改为 vendor 源码快照

- `backend/Cargo.toml` 的 `lithe-plugin-sdk` 从 tag `sdk-rust-v0.1.0`（e689971）改为 `path = "../vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk"`；`backend/Cargo.lock` 只删除了对应的 git source 行。
- 新增 `vendor/lithe-plugin-sdk/`（Apache-2.0）。基线是 lithe-plugin-docs `29b245c0e1d77c761d9032a3144a301d1818bfc7`，加上 SDK PR #17 的日志改动；`source-provenance.json` 记录基线、本地改动和逐文件 SHA-256。
- 新增 `scripts/verify-sdk-source.mjs` 逐文件校验来源；CI 新增 “Verify SDK source provenance”，`scripts/package.mjs` 打包前也会先跑。

## 诊断行为（`backend/src/service.rs`）

- 按注册抑制成功事实（失败照常 ERROR）：`containers.list`、`containers.logs`、`containers.stats`、`containers.top`、`contexts.list`、`engine.info`、`events.next`、`images.list`、`images.logo`、`networks.list`、`objects.inspect`、`system.df`、`volumes.list`、`files.list`、`files.uploadBegin`、`files.uploadChunk`。
- 引擎连接健康状态用一个 `AtomicU8` 保存，按状态变化去重：
  - `engine.info` 把“不可达”作为降级的成功结果返回（SDK 不会记失败），状态变化时上报一次 `degraded("engine.info", code)`。`code` 按错误分类：`context_not_found`、`unsupported_host`、`permission_denied`、`connection_lost`，其余为 `unreachable`。UI 反复探测同一状态不会重复上报。
  - 之前处于降级状态、再次连通时，上报一次 `recovered("engine.info", "connection_restored")`；正常连通的探测保持静默。
- `containers.create` 自动拉取缺失镜像后创建成功，上报 `recovered("containers.create", "missing_image_pulled")`。
- `compose.action` 下线时有网络因 `docker.conflict` 仍被占用而保留，上报 `degraded("compose.action", "networks_in_use", count)`。
- `main.rs`：`listen` 之前的启动失败不再 `eprintln!`，以退出码结束，由宿主进程生命周期记录。

## 端到端测试与 CI

- `scripts/e2e.mjs` 必须显式传 `--source` 和 `--ref`（新 SDK 要求 Core 支持 `litheLogging` 1）。
- `e2e/docker_plugin.rs`：除上面列出的高频调用外，每次调用（以及所有失败调用）都断言恰好一条类型化终态事实，并核对通道、级别（成功 INFO，失败 ERROR）、`operation` 和 op 关联。
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 与 `release.yml` 的 e2e 改为 `--source https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA.git --ref preview`。
- README 新增“宿主日志接入”一节。

## 验证

- 本地（`backend/` 目录，与 CI 一致）：`cargo fmt --all -- --check`、`cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` 通过；`cargo test --locked` 27 项通过；`node scripts/verify-sdk-source.mjs` 通过。
- 此前在 Codex 工作区对本地宿主分支跑了 e2e：真实的缺失 context 连续探测三次只产生一条 WARN，非法动作记 ERROR，Core 中的 op 关联正确。

## 预期的 CI 状态与合并顺序

- 宿主 #1699 合并进 `preview` 之前，CI 和 release 的 e2e 会因 Core 不支持 `litheLogging` 1 而失败，这是预期结果。
- 合并顺序：宿主 #1699 → SDK #17（先同步 `contract/v1`）→ 本 PR。发布前把 vendor 的 SDK 重新固定到 SDK #17 合并后的 commit。
- 本 PR 没有改插件版本号。

## 限制

- 没有连接真实 Docker daemon 做完整流程验收（创建、compose、文件上传等只在单元测试和 e2e 中覆盖）。
- 只覆盖 macOS 宿主；Windows 仍是 v1 writer。

配套 PR：
- 宿主 Core：https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/1699
- SDK：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docs/pull/17
- Database 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-database/pull/2
- Docker 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-docker/pull/3（本 PR）
- HTTP Client 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-http-client/pull/5
- Cargo 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-cargo/pull/5
- SVN 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-svn/pull/2
- Maven 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-maven/pull/9
- Lua 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-lua/pull/6
- Go 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go/pull/3
- Gradle 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-gradle/pull/5
- LLDB 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-lldb/pull/3
- PHP 插件：https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-php/pull/3

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#10.title: fix(debug): Delve 在当前文件所在的包目录构建、调试和运行
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#10.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#10.body:
## 背景

如果打开的文件夹根目录没有 `go.mod`，而是并排放着几个模块，例如课程目录下的 `cnscc368-1…4`，调试其中某个模块的 `main.go` 会报 `Failed to launch: Build error ... go.mod file not found`。原因是 Delve 在工作区根目录执行 `go build`。即使能编译，被调程序也在根目录运行，`examples/topo1.txt` 这类按包目录写的相对路径打不开。

用 Delve 1.27.2 的 DAP 实测，需要同时满足下面三点：

- `dlvCwd` ← 包目录：Delve 先 `os.Chdir(dlvCwd)` 再执行 `go build`。
- `env.PWD` ← 包目录：Delve 不更新 `PWD`；`go` 只在 `PWD` 和真实目录一致时用它。路径经过符号链接（macOS 的 `/var`）时，如果不设 `PWD`，会报 `outside main module`，断点报 `could not find file`。
- `cwd` ← 包目录：调试引擎在 launch 参数缺 `cwd` 时会填工作区根目录。

## 改动

- `io.github.lithe-idea.go-support/plugin.json`，Delve 的 launch 配置：
  - `arguments`：`{"mode": "debug", "program": ".", "env": {"GO111MODULE": "auto"}}`。`program: "."` 配合 `dlvCwd` 构建当前包；`GO111MODULE=auto` 让没有 `go.mod` 的目录按 GOPATH 模式构建目录里的全部文件。
  - `targetBindings`：`{"cwd": "target.directory", "args": "target.arguments", "adapterArguments": {"dlvCwd": "target.directory", "env.PWD": "target.directory"}}`，去掉了原来的 `program` 和 `env` 绑定。
- `e2e/host/desktop/internal/workbench/official_go_plugin_debug_e2e_test.go`：新增 `TestOfficialGoPluginDebugsEachProjectOfAWorkspaceWithDelve`。工作区根目录没有 `go.mod`，包含：
  - `lab-1`、`lab-2` 两个模块，其中 `lab-2` 读取包目录下的 `examples/greeting.txt`，读不到就 panic；
  - `lab-2/cmd/tool` 子包；
  - 没有 `go.mod` 的 `scratch` 目录。

  测试依次调试 `lab-2/main.go`、`lab-2/cmd/tool/main.go`、`scratch/main.go`，检查断点命中的文件和行号、程序正常结束，并确认没有留下 `__debug_bin*`。
- `e2e/host/lithe-host.json`：测试正则加入新测试。
- `README.md`：调试一节说明包目录、多模块工作区和没有 `go.mod` 的目录。
- `docs/feature-matrix.md`：`go-debug-delve` 更新能力说明和宿主依赖。

## 依赖与发版

- 依赖 Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-core-rust#55，它新增了 `targetBindings.adapterArguments` 和 `cwd` ← `target.directory`。还依赖桌面端固定这个 Core 的 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1975。
- 旧宿主不认识 `adapterArguments`（`deny_unknown_fields`），会拒绝安装这个版本。合入后不要马上发版，要等包含 #55 的桌面端版本发布。

## 验证

- `node scripts/package.mjs`：打包通过。
- `TestOfficialGoPluginBuildsAndServesAModule`：在固定 Core 671cdc6 的宿主分支上通过。
- 调试 e2e 在 671cdc6 上暴露了 `cwd` 落到工作区根目录的问题（lab-2 读文件 panic），于是 Core #55 增加了 `cwd` ← `target.directory`。
- 合入后补跑（2026-11-15）：`node scripts/e2e-host.mjs --ref fix/core-pin-56-merge`，宿主为 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1976（Core `9425469`，即 #55 + #56 在 Core main 上的提交），插件包来自 main `8595a25`。`TestOfficialGoPluginDebugsEachProjectOfAWorkspaceWithDelve` 和 `TestOfficialGoPluginBuildsAndServesAModule` 都通过。`docs/feature-matrix.md` 的“最近验证”和 `e2e/host/lithe-host.json` 的宿主固定版本，等 #1976 合入后另开 PR 更新。

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#11.title: release: 重发 Go Support 1.0.0（需要带 Lithe-core-rust#55 的桌面端）
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#11.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#11.body:
## 背景

1.0.0 预发布（tag 在 05abe46）发布后几分钟内撤回：它的 Delve 调试在工作区根目录执行 `go build`，根目录没有 `go.mod`、并排放多个模块时报 `Build error`，修复在 #10。v1.0.0 的 GitHub Release 和 tag 已删除，从包含 #10 的 main 重发同一版本号。

## 改动

- `docs/releases/v1.0.0.md`：
  - 调试功能补充：程序在包目录构建和运行，相对路径从包目录算起；根目录不需要 `go.mod`，可以并排放多个模块；子包和没有 `go.mod` 的目录也能调试。
  - 升级说明和兼容性第一条：需要固定了 Lithe-core-rust#55 的桌面端（1lck/Lithe-IDEA#1975）。更早的桌面端不认识 `targetBindings.adapterArguments`，也不允许 `cwd` 绑到 `target.directory`，会拒绝安装。
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`：`PRERELEASE_TAGS` 上方的注释同步新的宿主要求。v1.0.0 仍按预发布发布。

## 合入后

1. 在合入后的 main 上推送 `v1.0.0` tag，`release.yml` 会重新打包并创建预发布。
2. Lithe Store 的 `lithe-plugin-index.json` 里 1.0.0 的 `sha256` 还是撤回包的 `e7089f29…`，要改成新包的哈希，否则从 Store 安装会校验失败。

## 验证

- `node scripts/package.mjs --expect-tag v1.0.0`：通过。

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#13.title: Add Windows ARM64 and x64 package (1.0.1)
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#13.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#13.body:
## 改动

- `scripts/package.mjs` 把 darwin 包按字节复制成 `go-support-<版本>-windows.zip`，同时用于 Windows ARM64 和 x64。插件只声明 Lithe 怎样启动用户自己的 go、gopls、dlv：GOROOT 里解析 `bin/go.exe`，`gopls`、`dlv` 按 PATHEXT 找到 `.exe`。
- `scripts/package/windows.test.mjs`：两个包摘要相同，Windows 布局是 `bin/go.exe`，所有条目名在 Windows 上可解压（无保留名、非法字符、大小写重复）。
- 新增 `scripts/test.mjs`：用真实的 go 在带空格的临时目录里按 Go 项目模板生成模块，按清单逐条运行版本探测、模型和依赖（JSON 流）、build、vet、过滤后的 test、`go env` 目录，再把 gopls 和 dlv 托管安装到独立 `GOBIN`，检查 gopls 校验参数和 `dlv dap` 端点公告。
- CI：`package` 任务加 Windows 包校验并上传 Windows 包；新 `commands` 任务在 `windows-latest`、`windows-11-arm`、`macos-latest` 上跑 `scripts/test.mjs`，Windows 上测解压到 `Lithe Plugins` 目录的 windows 包。
- `release.yml`：发布前跑包校验；`PRERELEASE_TAGS` 加 `v1.0.1`。
- 版本 1.0.1（只多了 Windows 包，插件行为不变）；功能矩阵、README、`docs/releases/v1.0.1.md`。

## 验证

本地 macOS（go1.27.4 darwin/arm64）：`node scripts/package.mjs`、`node --test scripts/package/*.test.mjs` 2/2、`node scripts/test.mjs` 10/10（含真实的 gopls、dlv 安装）。Windows 结果看本 PR 的 CI；功能矩阵里 Windows 仍是 `pending`，需要在 Windows 版 Lithe 里手工验收。

## 发布

合并后推 `v1.0.1` 标签；预发布会被 Store 自动追踪跳过，需要手工提交 Store 条目（darwin-arm64、darwin-x64、windows-arm64、windows-x64，用 Release 附件的真实 SHA-256）。
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#13.head: feat/windows-packages

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#14.title: Report Delve's missing windows/arm64 backend as a skip
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#14.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#14.body:
#13 合并时 CI 的 `commands (windows-11-arm)` 失败，这是它的后续修复（原来推在 #13 分支上，合并时还没包含）。

原因：Delve 1.27.2 不支持 windows/arm64，`go install github.com/go-delve/delve/cmd/dlv@latest` 在 Delve 自己的构建里报 `your_windows_architecture_is_not_supported_by_delve`，之后的 `dlv dap` 检查又因为没有 dlv 报 `spawn dlv ENOENT`。这不是插件的问题，插件契约也无法按 CPU 架构隐藏安装器。

- `scripts/test.mjs`：只在 dlv 安装输出里出现 Delve 这个“架构不支持”的包名时，把 dlv 的安装和 `dlv dap` 两项记为跳过（`- 名称: 原因`），其他失败照常算失败。
- README、`docs/feature-matrix.md`、`docs/releases/v1.0.1.md`：写明 Windows ARM64 上没有调试，代码智能、构建、检查、测试和运行不受影响；feature matrix 的 go-debug-delve 改为 partial。

windows-latest、windows-11-arm 的其余检查和 macos-latest 在 #13 的 CI 里已经通过（run 43725999537），这个 PR 的 CI 应该三个平台全绿。
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#14.head: fix/windows-arm64-delve-skip

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#15.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#15.body:

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#17.title: feat: gopls 的索引排除改由清单声明 indexingExclusions
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#17.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#17.body:
## 关联 Issue / Linked issue

- Refs https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/issues/1856（第 2 项）
- 依赖 https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-core-rust/pull/68

## 改动说明 / What changes

Lithe 原来在 Core 里按 provider 名字 `go` 写死 gopls 的索引排除：把用户排除在索引之外的目录写进 `gopls.directoryFilters`。Lithe-core-rust#68 删除了这段特判，改成语言服务器在清单里声明 `indexingExclusions`，Core 只按声明填充。本 PR 给 gopls 补上这份声明。

- `plugin.json`：`languageServers[0]` 加
  ```json
  "indexingExclusions": {
    "section": "gopls.directoryFilters",
    "entry": "-${path}",
    "rootEntry": "-",
    "default": ["-**/node_modules"],
    "pathSyntax": "glob"
  }
  ```
  效果与原来 Core 的写死逻辑一致：每个排除的目录写成 `-<相对路径>`，工作区根目录写成 `-`；配置里没有 `directoryFilters` 时从 gopls 的默认值 `-**/node_modules` 开始追加；目录名含 `* ? [ ] { }` 的不写入。用户自己设置的项保留在前面。
- `README.md`：“工作方式”加一条说明；“兼容性”写明这个字段需要固定了包含 Lithe-core-rust#68 的 Core 的桌面端。
- `docs/feature-matrix.md`：`go-support-plugin` 的能力和依赖的宿主能力补上 `indexingExclusions`。

## 为什么是 Draft，什么时候可以合入

旧桌面端的 `LanguageServerDeclaration` 拒绝不认识的字段（`deny_unknown_fields`），会拒绝带 `indexingExclusions` 的整份清单。所以顺序是：

1. Lithe-core-rust#68 合入 Core `main`；
2. 桌面端把 `PINNED_CORE_REVISION` 升到合入后的 commit 并发布；
3. 本 PR：把 `e2e/host/lithe-host.json` 的 `revision` 升到第 2 步的桌面端 commit，跑一遍 `node scripts/e2e-host.mjs`，升版本号写发布说明，然后 ready、合入、发版。

第 2 步到第 3 步之间，gopls 拿不到排除目录，会照常索引被排除的目录；宿主仍然不向它发送这些目录里的文档、诊断和文件变化。

## 验证 / Verification

| 命令或操作 | 平台 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/package.mjs` | macOS arm64 | 通过 |
| `LITHE_CORE_RUST_DIR=<Lithe-core-rust#68 分支> LITHE_TEST_GO_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE=dist/go-support-1.0.1-darwin.zip node scripts/e2e-host.mjs --ref cad5656005288a7ef5897abd9d15494d2faf2fde`（桌面端 `main`，固定的 Core 957a349 正是 #68 的基点） | macOS arm64 | 通过：projectgen 5 个、workbench 2 个（含 `TestOfficialGoPluginBuildsAndServesAModule`：清单被接受，gopls 诊断和 gofumpt 设置照常生效） |

这次 e2e 的临时模块里没有被排除的目录，所以它证明的是“宿主接受这份清单、gopls 照常工作”；`directoryFilters` 填出来的内容由 Lithe-core-rust#68 的单元测试按同一份声明断言。`e2e/host/lithe-host.json` 的固定版本没有改，因为还没有包含 #68 的桌面端 commit。Windows 没有在本机执行。
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#17.head: refactor/1856-indexing-exclusions

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#18.title: feat: 声明 Go 构建和 Go 测试运行配置类型（2.0.0 预发布）
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#18.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#18.body:
> 注：本 PR 合入时版本号是 2.0.0（预发布）。下面写的 1.1.0 和正式发布在 #19。

## 关联 Issue / Linked issue

- Refs https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/issues/2100
- 依赖 https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/2148（已合入 main）和 https://github.com/Lithe-IDEA/Lithe-core-rust/pull/94（已合入，Core 661ef0f）

## 改动说明 / What changes

宿主 #2148 让插件用 `buildSystems[].runConfigurationTypes`（API-29）声明自己的运行配置类型。本 PR 让 Go Support 声明两种类型，界面参照 GoLand 的 Go Build 和 Go Test。先按现有契约出一版，没有改 Core 或宿主。

- `plugin.json`
  - 版本升到 **1.1.0**：加功能升次版本号。需要桌面端 0.8.6 或更新版本，按维护者的决定作为正式版本发布：Store 按版本的 `requires` 给更早的桌面端继续提供 1.0.1。README 的版本规则同步改为：修复升修订号，加功能升次版本号，只有特别大的革新才升主版本号（原来写的是不兼容就升主版本号）。`requires` 加 `runConfigurationTypes: 0`。
  - `build`（Go 构建，`execution: application`）
    - 运行种类：软件包、文件或目录，默认软件包，按 `visibleWhen` 只显示对应的一项。
    - 软件包路径：必填，导入路径或相对路径。
    - 文件、目录：必填，存为相对项目的路径，运行时传绝对路径。
    - Go 工具实参。
    - 拼成 `go run ${optionArguments} <Go 工具实参> <软件包|文件|目录> ${userArguments}`。
  - `test`（Go 测试，`execution: task`）
    - 测试种类：目录或软件包，默认软件包。
    - 软件包路径：默认 `./...`。
    - 目录：传 `<目录>/...`。
    - 模式：作为 `-run <模式>` 传入。
    - Go 工具实参。
    - 拼成 `go test ${optionArguments} <Go 工具实参> [-run 模式] <软件包|目录/...> ${userArguments}`。
  - 两种类型的图标都是 `icons/go.svg`。
- `l10n/zh-Hans.json`：两种类型的名称（Go 构建、Go 测试）、说明、字段标题、说明、占位符和选项名。
- `scripts/test.mjs`：按契约规则展开字段，用真实的 go 跑以下四项：
  - 用导入路径和相对路径运行软件包的 Go 构建，带 `-mod=mod` 和含空格的程序参数；
  - 用绝对路径运行文件和目录的 Go 构建；
  - 软件包加模式、目录加模式的 Go 测试，检查只跑了 TestGreet；
  - 默认 `./...` 的 Go 测试，检查失败的测试会让它失败。
- e2e（`e2e/host/`）
  - 新增 `official_go_plugin_run_types_e2e_test.go`：装真实插件包，在「运行/调试配置」对话框里新建并运行两种配置。
    - 检查中文名称和字段，以及切换种类后显示的字段。
    - Go 构建输出 `echo: one|two`。
    - Go 测试只跑 TestGreet。
    - 两条配置都写进 `.lithe/run/plugin/io.github.lithe-idea.go-support.toml`，插件安装目录不变。
  - `lithe-host.json` 固定到宿主 main `a8797ae`（含 #2148），把新测试加入 workbench 的正则。
  - 修改 `official_go_plugin_e2e_test.go` 的 `runBuildTaskToEnd` 和 `runTargetEntryToEnd`。宿主 #2119 起运行可以并行，构建窗口的状态行不再对应某一次执行，运行入口也不再占用 `build.operation`。现在改为等每次执行自己结束，从它的 Run 窗口会话读结果和输出。
- `README.md`：新增“运行配置”一节和功能表一行。兼容性写明 1.1.0 需要包含 #2148 的桌面端（0.8.6 起）、作为正式版本收录到 Store；e2e 示例改用 1.1.0 的包；发布一节把 `v1.1.0` 列为正式版本。
- `docs/feature-matrix.md`：新增 `go-run-configuration-types`，写明证据、依赖的宿主能力、限制、最近验证和验收步骤。
- `docs/releases/v1.1.0.md`：发布说明，包含已在 main 上但还没发版的 `indexingExclusions`（#17）。
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`：`PRERELEASE_TAGS` 不加 `v1.1.0`，注释写明它需要 0.8.6 起的桌面端、作为正式版本发布的原因。

## 和 GoLand 还不一样的地方（后续再优化）

以下差异需要改 Core 或宿主，这一版没有动：

- 插件字段排在宿主的工作目录和环境变量前面；GoLand 的顺序不同。
- 选项显示为分段按钮，不是下拉框。
- 名称行里“存为项目文件”在“允许多个实例”前面；GoLand 是反过来的。
- 目录字段不能有默认值，所以 Go 测试的目录不会默认填项目根目录。
- 名称不会按所选软件包自动生成。
- 类型图标按执行类别显示宿主图标，不显示插件包里的 Go 图标。
- 还没有的字段：输出目录、构建后运行、模拟终端、重定向输入、以 sudo 运行、模块、测试框架、使用所有自定义构建标记。
- 宿主不允许调试插件声明的类型。

## 验证 / Verification

| 命令或操作 | 平台 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/package.mjs` | macOS arm64 | 通过，darwin 和 windows 包 SHA-256 相同 |
| `node --test scripts/package/*.test.mjs` | macOS arm64 | 2 个通过 |
| `LITHE_TEST_INSTALL=0 node scripts/test.mjs`（Go 1.27.4） | macOS arm64 | 全部通过，含 4 个新增的运行配置检查；gopls 和 dlv 的联网安装按开关跳过 |
| CI 的 Store 校验（本机 Lithe-store main 74e23e3 的 `validate-index.mjs`） | macOS arm64 | 两个包都通过 |
| `LITHE_TEST_GO_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE=$PWD/dist/go-support-1.1.0-darwin.zip node scripts/e2e-host.mjs`（宿主 a8797ae） | macOS arm64 | projectgen 5 个、workbench 3 个全部通过，含新增的 `TestOfficialGoPluginRunsGoBuildAndGoTestConfigurations` 和改过等待方式的 `TestOfficialGoPluginBuildsAndServesAModule` |

还没做的：

- 没有在 Lithe 里手工验收，验证列保持 `pending`。
- Windows 只会跑 CI 里的 `scripts/test.mjs`，没有在 Windows 版 Lithe 里运行过。
- e2e 没有覆盖重新打开项目后配置还在、允许多个实例和启动前步骤。

## 发布

合入后推 `v1.1.0` 标签发正式版本，Store 的自动追踪会收录它；桌面端 0.8.5 及更早版本按 `requires` 继续得到 1.0.1。
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#18.head: feat/run-configuration-types

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#19.title: release: 版本改为 1.1.0，作为正式版本发布
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#19.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#19.body:
## 关联 Issue / Linked issue

- Refs https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/issues/2100
- 接着 #18：#18 合入时版本还是 2.0.0（预发布）。版本改为 1.1.0、正式发布这几个提交是在它合入之后才推上去的，所以单独开这个 PR。

## 改动说明 / What changes

#18 带来的功能没有变化，这个 PR 只改版本号、发布方式和对应的文字。

- 版本号从 2.0.0 改为 **1.1.0**。插件的规则是：加功能升次版本号，修复升修订号，只有特别大的革新才升主版本号（与 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2156 里 `release-lithe` 的插件规则一致）。
  - `plugin.json` 的 `version` 改为 1.1.0。
  - 发布说明 `docs/releases/v2.0.0.md` 改名为 `v1.1.0.md`。
  - README、功能矩阵和 `e2e/host/lithe-host.json` 里的示例包名都改成 `go-support-1.1.0-darwin.zip`。
- 改为**正式版本**发布，与 1.0.1 的做法一样。
  - `release.yml` 的 `PRERELEASE_TAGS` 不含 `v1.1.0`，注释写明了原因：
    - 桌面端 0.8.6 是第一个包含 1lck/Lithe-IDEA#2148（Core Lithe-core-rust#94）的发布；
    - 发正式版本，Store 的自动追踪才会收录它；
    - Store 索引记录每个版本的 `requires`，更早的桌面端会继续得到 1.0.1。
  - README 兼容性一段和发布一节、发布说明的开头和兼容性、功能矩阵的 macOS 说明，都改成需要桌面端 0.8.6 或更新版本，更早的桌面端在 Store 里继续得到 1.0.1。
- README 发布一节第 1 步的版本规则：
  - 修复升修订号，加功能升次版本号；
  - 特别大的革新才升主版本号，由维护者决定；
  - 新功能需要的宿主能力还没发布时，照样升次版本号，作为预发布发布。

## 验证 / Verification

| 命令或操作 | 平台 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/package.mjs` | macOS arm64 | 通过，生成 `go-support-1.1.0-{darwin,windows}.zip`，两个包 SHA-256 相同 |
| `node --test scripts/package/*.test.mjs` | macOS arm64 | 2 个通过 |
| `actionlint .github/workflows/release.yml` | macOS arm64 | 通过 |
| `LITHE_TEST_GO_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE=$PWD/dist/go-support-1.1.0-darwin.zip node scripts/e2e-host.mjs`（宿主 a8797ae） | macOS arm64 | projectgen 5 个、workbench 3 个全部通过。插件包内容在那之后没有变化，这个 PR 之后只改了文档和工作流 |

## 发布

合入后在合并提交上推 `v1.1.0` 标签，`Release` 工作流会发布正式版本，Store 的自动追踪会收录它。

Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#20.title: feat: Go 构建和 Go 测试换成各自的图标（1.2.0 预发布）
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#20.author: xiaoyumuxi
Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-go#20.body:
## 关联 Issue / Linked issue

- Refs https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/issues/2100
- 依赖 https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/pull/2169（宿主读取插件包里的运行类型图标，还没合入）

## 改动说明 / What changes

「运行/调试配置」里 Go 构建和 Go 测试原来共用 `icons/go.svg`，宿主也只按执行类别显示通用图标。#2169 让宿主绘制插件包里的类型图标（浅色、深色两份），本 PR 给两种类型各换一个 GoLand 风格的图标：Go 地鼠加构建标记、Go 地鼠加测试标记。

- `plugin.json`
  - 版本升到 **1.2.0**：加功能升次版本号。
  - `build`（Go 构建）的 `icon` 改为 `icons/go-build.svg`，`darkPath` 为 `icons/go-build-dark.svg`。
  - `test`（Go 测试）的 `icon` 改为 `icons/go-test.svg`，`darkPath` 为 `icons/go-test-dark.svg`。
  - 两种仍是 `mode: original`，按文件自身配色绘制。
- `icons/`
  - 新增 `go-build.svg`、`go-build-dark.svg`：Go 地鼠缩小放到左下，构建锤子缩小放到右上，合成一个 16×16 图标。
  - 新增 `go-test.svg`、`go-test-dark.svg`：Go 地鼠在左下，红绿两色的测试标记在右上。
  - 图形改编自 JetBrains IntelliJ Community 的 `language/go.svg`、`expui/build/build.svg`、`expui/runConfigurations/junitTestMark.svg`（Apache-2.0）。`icons/NOTICE` 写明来源文件、commit、版权和改动；`icons/LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt` 是许可证全文。不带后缀的用浅色源文件配色，`-dark` 用 `_dark` 源文件配色。
  - `icons/go.svg` 保留不变：清单里已不再引用它，但它是 Lithe Store 列表用的插件图标（#1 加入）。
- e2e（`e2e/host/`）
  - `official_go_plugin_run_types_e2e_test.go`：新增检查，两种类型都能从安装的包里读到浅色和深色图标，两套配色不同。
  - `lithe-host.json`：示例包名改为 `dist/go-support-1.2.0-darwin.zip`。**`revision` 还固定在 `a8797ae`**，那里没有 #2169 的 `runTypePackageIcon`，新增检查无法编译。#2169 合入后要把它升到包含 #2169 的 main commit，然后再把本 PR 标为 ready。
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`：`PRERELEASE_TAGS` 加上 `v1.2.0`。图标依赖还没发版的宿主能力，按版本规则作为预发布版本发布。
- `README.md`
  - 兼容性一节说明 1.2.0 的图标需要 #2169，作为预发布版本发布；桌面端 0.8.6 也能安装，只显示通用图标。
  - 发布一节把 `v1.2.0` 列入预发布版本。
- `docs/feature-matrix.md`（`go-run-configuration-types`）
  - 能力和证据写上包里的图标和 `icons/NOTICE`。
  - 依赖的宿主能力加上 #2169。
  - 限制删掉“类型图标按执行类别显示宿主图标”。
  - 验收第 1 步加上看图标的步骤。
  - 新增一段“类型图标”的最近验证。
- `docs/releases/v1.2.0.md`：发布说明。

## 验证

macOS（Apple Silicon），Go 1.27.4：

- `node scripts/package.mjs`：通过，生成 `dist/go-support-1.2.0-{darwin,windows}.zip`。
- `node --test scripts/package/*.test.mjs`：2/2 通过。
- `node scripts/test.mjs`：通过。
- `LITHE_TEST_GO_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE=<绝对路径>/dist/go-support-1.2.0-darwin.zip node scripts/e2e-host.mjs --source <Lithe 检出> --ref fix/run-config-dialog-polish`，宿主为 #2169 分支 `0ffbbd6`（Core `0a15a98`）：
  - projectgen 的 5 个测试全部通过；
  - workbench 的 3 个测试全部通过：Delve 调试、构建并运行模块、Go 构建/Go 测试（含新增的图标检查）。
- 两种类型的浅色和深色截图在 #2169 的 PR 描述里（“+”类型菜单那一行）。

## 没做的

- `lithe-host.json` 的 `revision` 要等 #2169 合入后再升，在此之前本 PR 保持 Draft。
- 还没在 Lithe 里手工验收图标，Windows 没有验证。
